        async function nestDownload(place) {
          let res;
          try {
            res = await fetch(nestBaseUrl() + '/result_svg');
          } catch (err) {
            toast('Nesting server unreachable at ' + nestBaseUrl() + ' (' + err.message + ')');
            return;
          }
          if (res.status === 404) { toast('No nesting result yet · run the nesting and press "Select as Best" first'); return; }
          if (!res.ok) { toast('Nesting download failed · HTTP ' + res.status); return; }
          let text = await res.text();
          const i = text.indexOf('<');
          if (i > 0) text = text.slice(i);
          let ir;
          try { ir = svgImportParse(text, {}); } catch (err) { toast('Nesting result is not valid SVG'); return; }
          if (!ir.items || !ir.items.length) { toast('Nesting result is empty'); return; }
          if (place) { nestPlaceAt(ir, place); return; }
          ui.nestPlace = ir;
          toast('Click where the nested result should be placed · right click cancels');
        }
      
        function cmdNest() {
          if (xfBlock()) return;
          const sel = selectedEntitiesForExport();
          const markers = [];
          const geom = [];
          for (const e of sel) {
            const mk = nestMarkerOf(e);
            if (mk) { markers.push(e); continue; }
            // A note is pure annotation and never cuts. Text, on the other hand, is
            // real cut geometry: nestSvgString sends its glyph outlines. It used to be
            // dropped here, which is why a selected text arrived with no data.
            if (e.type === 'note') continue;
            geom.push(e);
          }
          if (geom.length) { nestUpload(geom); return; }
          if (markers.length) {
            const anchor = P(markers[0].type === 'note' ? markers[0].p : markers[0].p0);
            nestDownload(anchor ? { x: anchor.x, y: anchor.y } : null);
            return;
          }
          nestDownload(null);
        }

        // ---- Nesting (KaryaCNC nesting server) ------------------------------
        // Mirrors the KaryaCNC Inkscape extension protocol: POST /upload_svg with a
        // multipart svg_data file (plus inkscape=y), GET /result_svg returns the
        // nested SVG (404 = no result yet). A text/comment whose content is exactly
        // "nest" or "result" is the marker: with geometry it uploads, alone it
        // downloads; with no selection at all the download asks for a drop point.
        const NEST_PORT = 3000;
        function nestBaseUrl() {
          // same host as KaryaCNC, resolved with the same rules as the WS connection
          // (full IP, or just the last octet as typed in the KaryaCNC settings window)
          return 'http://' + cncResolveHost(cnc && cnc.host) + ':' + NEST_PORT;
        }
      
        function nestMarkerOf(e) {
          if (!e || (e.type !== 'note' && e.type !== 'text')) return null;
          const t = String(e.text || '').trim().toLowerCase();
          return t === 'nest' || t === 'result' ? t : null;
        }
      
        function nestSvgString(entities) {
          // mm coordinates, Y flipped to SVG space; colours ride along (the server
          // reads stroke styles, green lines included).
          //
          // CURVES STAY CURVES: circles go as <circle>, arcs as A commands and
          // splines as cubic Béziers — the server polygonizes for its own placement
          // math if it must, but what comes back and what any smarter server reads
          // is the true geometry, not a display-density polyline. Only straight-line
          // chains are welded into one loop per shape (that IS their geometry).
          const parts = ['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">'];
          const fy = (y) => (-y).toFixed(4);
          const fx = (x) => x.toFixed(4);
          const straight = [];   // line chains: entity -> polylines for loop welding
          // owned guide lines (group/text frames) never go to the nesting server;
          // manually drawn green lines are real marking paths and stay allowed
          const guides = ownedGuideIds();
          for (const e of entities) {
            if (guides.has(+e.id)) continue;
            const color = colorOf(e);
            const stroke = ' fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.25" style="fill:none;stroke:' + color + ';stroke-width:0.25"';
            if (e.type === 'circle') {
              // the server does not know <circle>: emit it as a full-circle path of
              // two A segments (same form the SVG export uses)
              const cd = circleData(e);
              if (cd && cd.r > 1e-6) {
                const sx = (cd.c.x + cd.r).toFixed(4), sy = fy(cd.c.y);
                const ex = (cd.c.x - cd.r).toFixed(4);
                const d = 'M ' + sx + ' ' + sy +
                  ' A ' + cd.r.toFixed(4) + ' ' + cd.r.toFixed(4) + ' 0 1 0 ' + ex + ' ' + sy +
                  ' A ' + cd.r.toFixed(4) + ' ' + cd.r.toFixed(4) + ' 0 1 0 ' + sx + ' ' + sy + ' Z';
                parts.push('<path d="' + d + '"' + stroke + '/>');
              }
              continue;
            }
            if (e.type === 'arc') {
              const d = svgArcPath(e);
              if (d) parts.push('<path d="' + d + '"' + stroke + '/>');
              continue;
            }
            // Text is traced on the fly, so it goes to the nesting server as its glyph
            // outlines — the same loops the canvas draws and the SVG export writes. A
            // single-line font yields open strokes; a filled font yields closed
            // contours. Without this branch text fell through to the straight-line
            // pool, where entityWorldPolylinep produced nothing, so it never shipped.
            if (e.type === 'text') {
              const outline = textOutlineWorld(e);
              for (const loop of outline.loops) {
                if (!loop || loop.length < 2) continue;
                let d = 'M ' + fx(loop[0].x) + ' ' + fy(loop[0].y);
                for (let i = 1; i < loop.length; i++) {
                  d += ' L ' + fx(loop[i].x) + ' ' + fy(loop[i].y);
                }
                if (outline.closed) d += ' Z';
                parts.push('<path d="' + d + '"' + stroke + '/>');
              }
              continue;
            }
            if (e.type === 'spline') {
              // one cubic Bézier per node span: true curve data, no sampling.
              // IMPORTANT: hs.o / hs.i are ABSOLUTE handle points (exportSVG moves
              // them by +=dx on paste, treats them as plain points), and hs.i is
              // indexed by the END point of the span — same convention as exportSVG.
              ensureSplineHandles(e);
              const cps = entityPointIds(e).map(id => P(id)).filter(Boolean);
              if (cps.length >= 2 && e.hs) {
                const n = cps.length;
                const loop = !!e.closed && n >= 3;
                const nsegs = loop ? n : n - 1;
                let d = 'M ' + fx(cps[0].x) + ' ' + fy(cps[0].y);
                for (let s = 0; s < nsegs; s++) {
                  const j = loop ? (s + 1) % n : s + 1;
                  const P1 = e.hs.o[s], P2 = e.hs.i[j], P3 = cps[j];
                  if (!P3) continue;
                  if (!P1 || !P2) {
                    d += ' L ' + fx(P3.x) + ' ' + fy(P3.y);
                    continue;
                  }
                  d += ' C ' + fx(P1.x) + ' ' + fy(P1.y) + ' ' + fx(P2.x) + ' ' + fy(P2.y) + ' ' + fx(P3.x) + ' ' + fy(P3.y);
                }
                if (loop) d += ' Z';
                parts.push('<path d="' + d + '"' + stroke + '/>');
              }
              continue;
            }
            // A clone (array kind='clone') is real cut geometry: every instance ships
            // as its own path, in the master's own colours. Without this branch the
            // array fell into the straight-line pool, where entityWorldPolylines knows
            // nothing about instances, so the clones never reached the server.
            if (e.type === 'array') {
              for (const t of arrayInstanceOffsets(e)) {
                for (const pl of arrayInstancePolylines(e, t)) {
                  if (!pl.pts || pl.pts.length < 2) continue;
                  const c = pl.color || color;
                  const st = ' fill="none" stroke="' + c + '" stroke-width="0.25" style="fill:none;stroke:' + c + ';stroke-width:0.25"';
                  let d = 'M ' + fx(pl.pts[0].x) + ' ' + fy(pl.pts[0].y);
                  for (let i = 1; i < pl.pts.length; i++) {
                    d += ' L ' + fx(pl.pts[i].x) + ' ' + fy(pl.pts[i].y);
                  }
                  if (pl.closed) d += ' Z';
                  parts.push('<path d="' + d + '"' + st + '/>');
                }
              }
              continue;
            }
            straight.push(e);
          }
          // straight-line entities: chain into real loops, one path per loop
          const byColor = new Map();
          for (const e of straight) {
            const color = colorOf(e);
            for (const pl of entityWorldPolylines(e)) {
              if (!pl.pts || pl.pts.length < 2) continue;
              if (!byColor.has(color)) byColor.set(color, []);
              byColor.get(color).push({ pts: pl.pts.map(p => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y })), closed: !!pl.closed });
            }
          }
          for (const [color, polys] of byColor) {
            let loops;
            try { loops = chainPolylines(polys, 0.05); } catch (err) { loops = polys; }
            for (const loop of loops) {
              const pts = loop.pts;
              if (!pts || pts.length < 2) continue;
              let d = 'M ' + fx(pts[0].x) + ' ' + fy(pts[0].y);
              for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
                d += ' L ' + fx(pts[i].x) + ' ' + fy(pts[i].y);
              }
              if (loop.closed) d += ' Z';
              parts.push('<path d="' + d + '" fill="none" stroke="' + color +
                '" stroke-width="0.25" style="fill:none;stroke:' + color + ';stroke-width:0.25"/>');
            }
          }
          parts.push('</svg>');
          return parts.join('\n');
        }
      
        async function nestUpload(entities) {
          const svg = nestSvgString(entities);
          if (svg.indexOf('<path') < 0 && svg.indexOf('<circle') < 0) { toast('Nothing to send: the selection has no geometry'); return; }
          // inspection hook: Shift+Nest downloads the exact payload instead of sending
          if (ui.shiftDown) {
            downloadBlob('nest-input.svg', new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' }));

            return;
          }
          if (typeof console !== 'undefined' && console.log) console.log('[nest] upload SVG', svg);
          const fd = new FormData();
          fd.append('inkscape', 'y');
          fd.append('svg_data', new Blob([svg], { type: 'image/svg+xml' }), 'input.svg');
          toast('Uploading ' + entities.length + ' objects to ' + nestBaseUrl() + '…');
          try {
            const res = await fetch(nestBaseUrl() + '/upload_svg', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
            if (!res.ok) { toast('Nesting upload failed · HTTP ' + res.status); return; }
            toast('Uploaded to nesting · run it there and press "Select as Best", then Nest again to download');
          } catch (err) {
            toast('Nesting server unreachable at ' + nestBaseUrl() + ' (' + err.message + ')');
          }
        }

          if (i > 0) text = text.slice(i);

          ui.nestPlace = ir;
          toast('Click where the nested result should be placed · right click cancels');

          render();

        // Everything a loop encloses: the entities whose nodes all sit inside its
        // polygon. The loop's own outline is skipped — loopEntities has that.
        function entitiesInsideLoop(loop) {
          const poly = loop.poly;
          if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return [];
          const own = new Set(loopEntities(loop).map(Number));
          const out = [];
          for (const eid in state.entities) {
            const id = +eid;
            if (own.has(id)) continue;
            const e = state.entities[eid];
            let any = false;
            let all = true;
            for (const pid of entityPointIds(e)) {
              const p = P(pid);
              if (!p) continue;
              any = true;
              if (!pointInPoly(p, poly)) { all = false; break; }
            }
            if (any && all) out.push(id);
          }
          return out;
        }
      
        // All loops containing the point, editable (active-layer) ones first, then
        // the rest by area. A NON-editable loop is a click-through: it may sit in
        // the list (Alt+click can still cycle to it deliberately), but a plain
        // click must land on the active layer's own loop — or on nothing, never on
        // another layer's shape.
        function hitLoopPicks(world) {
          if (!pickFilter.loop) return [];   // pick filter: loops locked
          const loops = getLoops();
          const out = [];
          for (const loop of loops) {
            if (loop.poly && loop.poly.length > 2 && pointInPoly(world, loop.poly)) out.push(loop);
          }
          const rank = (loop) => {
            for (const eid of loopEntities(loop)) {
              const e = state.entities[eid];
              if (e && entityEditable(e)) return 0;
            }
            return 1;
          };
          out.sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || a.area - b.area);
          return out;
        }
      
        function hitLoopPick(world) {
          return hitLoopPicks(world)[0] || null;
        }
      
        // Alt+click cycles downward through the stacked loops at the point; a plain
        // click resets the cycle to the smallest (top) one.
        function pickLoopAt(world, useAlt) {
          const all = hitLoopPicks(world);
          if (!all.length) return null;
          const last = ui.loopPick;
          const same = useAlt && all.length > 1 && last &&
            Math.abs(last.x - world.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(last.y - world.y) < 0.5 &&
            Date.now() - (last.at || 0) < 4000;
          const idx = same ? (last.idx + 1) % all.length : (useAlt ? Math.min(1, all.length - 1) : 0);
          ui.loopPick = { x: world.x, y: world.y, idx, at: Date.now() };
          return all[idx];
        }
      
        // Middle click: select the loop below the one a plain click would take.
        // Middle click walks DOWNWARD through what sits at one spot: points first,
        // then overlapping lines, then the loop below. The first click takes the one
        // below the topmost hit (not the first detected); repeats go deeper.
        function selectBelow(ev) {
          const pos = pointerPos(ev);
          const st = ui.belowState;
          const sameSpot = st && Math.abs(st.x - pos.x) < 6 && Math.abs(st.y - pos.y) < 6;
          const pick = (list, kind) => {
            const n = list.length;

> _Reasoning_
> Good: a plain click inside a loop selects the loop's own entities; Ctrl+click selects loop + everything inside (compound). This is exactly how "a compound loop counts as one object" could be detected: select outer loop with Ctrl+click, selection = outer + inner entities, but getLoops() gives separate loops. The nesting panel must group loops into "objects": loops where an inner loop's entity set is fully contained in a selected group? Better: build objects from selected entities by:
> 1. Take selected entity ids.
> 2. Find loops whose entity set is fully within the selection.
> 3. Group loops into compound objects by containment: loop A contains loop B (B's poly centroid inside A and B area < A area) and both selected → same object, holes = B.
> 4. Loops that are not contained → separate objects.

Could also support sheet from gray fill? Keep it simple: green loop = sheet per user request.

Actually I recall blob workers from file:// being blocked too. Not certain. The safe plan: cooperative chunked main-thread scheduler with progress + cancel, and note optional worker upgrade if served over http (the project has `server/` static dev server).     },

    /**
     * Intersection test between poly1 translated by (dx, dy) and poly2.
     * The translation is applied on the fly so no clone/array is allocated.
     * Sets poly1.insideBonus when poly1 fits fully inside a hole of poly2.
     */
    polygonsIntersectAt: function (poly1, dx, dy, poly2, checkchild = true) {
        // Add a small buffer to prevent touching edges
        const BUFFER = 0.1 * GEOM_SCALE;

        // Check bounding boxes first with buffer
        const bounds1 = poly1.getBounds();
        const bounds2 = poly2.getBounds();
        const bx = bounds1.x + dx;
        const by = bounds1.y + dy;

        if (!(bx + bounds1.width + BUFFER > bounds2.x &&
            bx - BUFFER < bounds2.x + bounds2.width &&
            by + bounds1.height + BUFFER > bounds2.y &&
            by - BUFFER < bounds2.y + bounds2.height)) {
            return false;
        }

        // if have child, check if poly1 fully inside poly2 childs
        if (poly2.paths.length > 1 && checkchild) {
            for (let i = 1; i < poly2.paths.length; i++) {
                if (!this.polyOutsideAt(poly1, dx, dy, poly2, i)) {
                    poly1.insideBonus = 10000 * GEOM_SCALE;
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        // Cache paths for faster access
        const path1 = poly1.paths[0];
        const path2 = poly2.paths[0];
        const len1 = path1.length;
        const len2 = path2.length;
        const last1 = len1 - 1;
        const last2 = len2 - 1;
        const pointInPolygonOffset = this.pointInPolygonOffset;
        const lineSegmentsIntersectXY = this.lineSegmentsIntersectXY;

        // Check if any translated point from poly1 is inside poly2.
        // Points outside poly2's bounding box are skipped — they can never be
        // inside its polygon, so this is a pure fast-reject (no semantic change).
        const b2x = bounds2.x, b2y = bounds2.y, b2w = bounds2.width, b2h = bounds2.height;
        for (let i = 0; i < len1; i++) {
            const pt = path1[i];
            const px = pt.x + dx, py = pt.y + dy;
            if (px < b2x || px > b2x + b2w || py < b2y || py > b2y + b2h) continue;
            if (pointInPolygonOffset(px, py, path2, 0, 0)) return true;
        }

        // Check if any point from poly2 is inside translated poly1.
        const b1x = bx, b1y = by, b1w = bounds1.width, b1h = bounds1.height;
        for (let i = 0; i < len2; i++) {
            const pt = path2[i];
            if (pt.x < b1x || pt.x > b1x + b1w || pt.y < b1y || pt.y > b1y + b1h) continue;
            if (pointInPolygonOffset(pt.x, pt.y, path1, dx, dy)) return true;
        }

        // Check for line segment intersections (with buffer)
        for (let i = 0; i < len1; i++) {
            const p1 = path1[i];
            const p1x = p1.x + dx;
            const p1y = p1.y + dy;
            const p2 = path1[i === last1 ? 0 : i + 1];
            const p2x = p2.x + dx;
            const p2y = p2.y + dy;
            const s1minX = p1x < p2x ? p1x : p2x;
            const s1maxX = p1x > p2x ? p1x : p2x;
            const s1minY = p1y < p2y ? p1y : p2y;
            const s1maxY = p1y > p2y ? p1y : p2y;
            for (let j = 0; j < len2; j++) {
                const p3 = path2[j];
                const p4 = path2[j === last2 ? 0 : j + 1];
                const p3x = p3.x, p3y = p3.y, p4x = p4.x, p4y = p4.y;
                // Correct segment-AABB rejection: skip only when the two
                // segments' ranges are actually separated. The two segments
                // are symmetric here, so the result is order-independent.
                const s2minX = p3x < p4x ? p3x : p4x;
                const s2maxX = p3x > p4x ? p3x : p4x;
                const s2minY = p3y < p4y ? p3y : p4y;
                const s2maxY = p3y > p4y ? p3y : p4y;
                if (s1maxX < s2minX || s2maxX < s1minX) continue;
                if (s1maxY < s2minY || s2maxY < s1minY) continue;
                if (lineSegmentsIntersectXY(p1x, p1y, p2x, p2y, p3x, p3y, p4x, p4y)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    },

    lineSegmentsIntersect: function (p1, p2, p3, p4) {
        return this.lineSegmentsIntersectXY(p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, p3.x, p3.y, p4.x, p4.y);
    },

    // Segment intersection using raw coordinates (no Point objects allocated).
    lineSegmentsIntersectXY: function (x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4) {
        // Inlined ccw orientation tests (avoid allocating a closure per call).
        // ccw(A, B, C) == (C.y - A.y) * (B.x - A.x) > (B.y - A.y) * (C.x - A.x)
        const ccw1 = (y4 - y1) * (x3 - x1) > (y3 - y1) * (x4 - x1);
        const ccw2 = (y4 - y2) * (x3 - x2) > (y3 - y2) * (x4 - x2);
        if (ccw1 === ccw2) return false;
        const ccw3 = (y3 - y1) * (x2 - x1) > (y2 - y1) * (x3 - x1);
        const ccw4 = (y4 - y1) * (x2 - x1) > (y2 - y1) * (x4 - x1);
        return ccw3 !== ccw4;

    pointInPolygonOffset: function (px, py, polygon, offX, offY) {

            const vi = polygon[i];
            const vj = polygon[j];
            const viY = vi.y + offY;
            const vjY = vj.y + offY;
            if (((viY > py) !== (vjY > py)) &&

                isInside = !isInside;
            }
        }
        return isInside;
    },

            const p = points[i];
            if (!this.pointInPolygonOffset(p.x + dx, p.y + dy, target, 0, 0)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    },

> _Reasoning_
> Key: polygon intersection uses only paths[0] (outer), but if poly2 has child paths (= holes), a part fully inside a hole gets an `insideBonus` and no collision — so nesting inside holes is supported. Conversely, a part's own holes (paths[1..]) are NOT obstacles for others (they'd be allowed to overlap another part's hole). Actually checkCollisions only checks the outer path of the moving variant, and placed part's outer path; so holes aren't collision-tested. That means another part can be placed inside a hole — correct; but it also means a part may be placed straddling a hole without colliding? Polygon intersection with outer path would catch a part crossing the outer boundary, but a part straddling a hole inside the outer shape: its points are inside the outer polygon, so collision IS flagged. Wait, if the part is inside the outer polygon of placed part → pointInPolygonOffset returns true → collision. Unless fully inside a hole → insideBonus. > _Reasoning_
> So spacing is implemented by Clipper-offsetting every part outward by `spacing/2` (distance * GEOM_SCALE/2 in clipper units; clipper "distance" units = points, GEOM_SCALE=1000 per mm, so `spacing * 1000/2` = spacing/2 mm → grows by spacing/2 each side → gap spacing between parts). This is a neat approach: grow each part by half the gap, nest expanded parts, then output the original geometry. MiniSketch has `offsetClosedChains(contours, dist)` using Clipper and `clipperLib()`. For compound parts (with holes), growing outward by half spacing requires offsetting outer outward and holes inward — ClipperOffset with jtMiter handles polygon orientation automatically if holes wound opposite. MiniSketch contours normalized (outer CCW, holes CW per core.normalizeWinding). The clipper offset in MiniSketch: check `offsetClosedChains` at 12661 to see how it handles holes. > 
> ### Coordinate spaces
> 
> Use two named spaces:
> - **World** (MiniSketch): mm, Y up.
> - **Sheet space**: origin at the sheet loop's bbox top-left, X right, Y **down** (mm). Conversion `toSheet(p) = { x: p.x - b.sx0, y: b.sy1 - p.y }`; inverse `toWorld(q) = { x: b.sx0 + q.x, y: b.sy1 - q.y }`.
> 
> Why Y down: the ported NFP2 scanline/score code keeps its exact semantics (`y` increasing downward = from the sheet's top edge). Note this is an aesthetic decision matching the reference: parts pack against the top edge. In world Y-up that's the top edge of the green sheet.
> 
> Output offset: `outputOriginX = b.sx1 + GAP` (right of the sheet). World mapping for output: `toWorldOut(q) = { x: outputOriginX + q.x, y: b.sy1 - q.y }` where q is in sheet space.
> 
> Wait: sheet space q measured from sheet's top-left; q.y from 0 downward; toWorld y = sy1 - q.y. For output, x shifted right: x = sx1 + GAP + q.x. Then the top edge of nesting result aligns with the sheet's top edge. Good.
> 
> ### Engine data model
> 
> ```
> input = {
>   sheet: { poly: [{x,y}], bbox: {x0, y0, w, h} },     // sheet space
>   objects: [{
>      key,                  // caller's object index
>      contours: [poly],     // sheet space, [0] = outer (CCW), rest = holes (CW)
>      spacingPoly: [poly],  // outer grown by spacing/2 (holes shrunk), or same
>      variants: [{ poly, angle, flip, matrix2x3 }], // precomputed, aligned to bbox top-left (0,0)
>      area, bbox
>   }],
>   opts: { spacing, step, popSize, generations, mutationRate, seed, rotationAngles, allowFlip, timeBudgetMs }
> }
> ```
> 
> Actually engine should own variant generation (rotation) so GA rotation genes map: `variants` built by engine from each object's contours.
> 
> For collision, each variant needs:
> - outer poly (array of {x,y}) aligned so bbox min = (0,0)
> - holes (for inside bonus)
> - bbox (w,h)
> 
> `findBestPlacement(variant, placed, sheet, step)`:
> - placed entries: { poly (outer, translated), bbox, holes[] }
> - scanline: for y = 0; y <= H; y += yStep:
>   - compute x intervals free: start with sheet interval(s) at y using sheet polygon intersections; subtract every placed outer poly's x-intersections at y (their interior spans). The reference does this by collecting intersections and walking pairs, plus skipping a part's span (x = ceil(intersections[i+1])). I'll port exactly.
>   - at each candidate x (step xStep): AABB test (x+w<=W... using sheet bbox; then sheet containment via all vertices in sheet poly? Reference tests sheetParts with polyOutsideAt, which is all variant points inside the green sheet — plus part-inside checks? Actually checkCollisions calls polyOutsideAt for each sheet part = every point of variant must be inside the sheet. That's a good sheet test (fails for a donut-shaped sheet if part bridges the hole, since points inside hole are not inside polygon... yes pointInPoly of a hole region returns false for the sheet polygon with hole? The sheet polygon is a single loop, not compound; if the green sheet loop itself has holes it's compound too.)
>   - freeze: before collision, if a best score exists and candidate score > bestScore + 100 skip.
>   - collision vs placed parts: AABB + `polysOverlap` (any vertex in the other, and any edge intersection) — must implement in core.js (pure): `polysOverlap(a, b)` (proper intersection; touching edges count as overlap because spacing grew the parts; also BUFFER small epsilon).
>   - inside-hole bonus: if fully inside one of a placed object's holes → allowed with bonus (mirror `insideBonus`). Then choose best score.
> - early exit: once best exists and y > H/3, break (reference). Plus `maxCandidates` budget (our addition, e.g. 20k) and stop when score is already top-left optimal? Keep.

Port it, but adapt: candidate positions from vertices of placed polys (with vSkip based on step), snap to sheet bbox; test each. Also our local refinement: around the best candidate, test 8 neighbors at step/2 (one level) — optional. > 
> ### Spatial hash
> Port `SpatialHash` (cell = max(50, step*5) mm — reference uses 50*GEOM_SCALE = 50mm min, actually cellSize = max(50*1000, gridSize*5) = 50000 units = 50mm). So cell = max(50, step*5) mm. Good.
> 
> ### GA
> Port `NFP_GA` exactly:
> - default popSize 6, generations 5, mutationRate 0.1 (matches reference defaults).
> - chromosome = permutation of entry indices + rotation gene per entry.
> - baseline order = entries sorted by longest side² descending; elitism keeps it → never worse.
> - order crossover OX, mutation (swap 50% / relocate 30% / invert 20%), uniform rotation crossover, rotate mutation with prob mutationRate.
> - fitness = bbox area of placed + unplaced area.
> - seed from previous run: keep `nestLastSeed` in panel state (not saved) so repeated runs improve.
> - The reference's decoder creates a fresh NFP2 per evaluation, resets spatial hash, uses fixed placements (none for us) and green sheet.
> 
> Multi-worker: reference uses up to 4 workers; we skip workers because of file:// (explain). Optionally, in a future served build, split GA populations across Web Workers. Note in plan.
> 
> ### Progress and chunking
> 
> Generator API:
> 
> ```
> function* runNest(input, opts) {

>   ...
>   return result;

> ```
> 
> At each part placement inside the decoder: `yield`. The scheduler resumes with `job.next()` within a time budget of ~8–12 ms per animation frame; writes progress to DOM at most every 100 ms. Stop sets `job.return()`/abandons.
> 
> Nested generator composition: decoder `_evaluate` is a generator that yields; the GA loop delegates with `yield*`. All pure, Node-friendly.
> 
> Cost: because yields happen inside candidate loops, decoder state persists across frames. The number of yields matters: e.g. yield once per part placement and once every 500 candidate positions. Scheduler loop: `while (performance.now() - t0 < 10) job.next()`. This is a clean cooperative design.
> 
> But caution: generator `yield*` overhead per yield is fine at ~thousands/sec.
> 
> ### Result mapping & output
> 
> For each object, engine returns:
> - `placements: [{ objKey, variant, dx, dy }]` in sheet space (dx,dy = translation of aligned variant).
> - Engine also returns `placedBounds` (sheet space), and `unplaced` list.
> 
> Output for each placement:
> - Compute matrix in **sheet space** that maps the object's **sheet-space source contours** (before alignment/rotation) to the placed position: M_sheet = T(dx,dy) · R(angle) · F(flip) · T(-srcBBox.origin)? Since variant poly was built as: take source contours → rotate about origin? (Reference `Path.rotate` rotates about origin, then `align()` translates bbox min to 0.) So variant poly = R·F·p + a where a is alignment translation. Placement adds (dx,dy). Thus M_sheet: p → R·F·p + a + (dx,dy).
> - Convert to world matrix: since sheet space is a reflection F0 of world, the matrix for world master points is conjugating: `M_world = F0⁻¹ · M_sheet · F0` where F0(p) = (p.x - sx0, sy1 - p.y) applied to world, and F0⁻¹(q) = (sx0 + q.x, sy1 - q.y). But the output origin also shifts X by `outputOriginX - sx0`. So define `G(q) = { x: outputOriginX + q.x, y: sy1 - q.y }` (sheet space → output world). Then `M_world = G · M_sheet · F0` (with F0 applied first). Compose 2x3 matrices: G = [1,0,0,-1, outputOriginX, sy1]; F0 = [1,0,0,-1, -sx0, sy1]; M_world = G · M_sheet · F0.
>   Let me verify: pW → F0 → M_sheet → qN → G → worldOut. Yes.
> - Since M_sheet includes a possible mirror (flip), M_world determinant sign flips accordingly; that's fine for clones.
> - However, the source contours in the clone masters are *world* geometry (all entities of the object), including holes. M_world maps them consistently. 
> 
> But must be careful: M_sheet is built from the object's sheet-space source contours, which are themselves F0(object world contours). Rotating/aligning in sheet space then conjugating gives exactly the mirrored-rotation behavior — verified algebraically. Alternatively simply map three points: take source world point p1, compute qN = M_sheet(F0(p1)), worldOut = G(qN), and solve a similarity from world p→world out. Plan can specify the conjugation formula plus a unit test (`similarityFrom3`) to catch sign errors. I'll specify the closed-form and a probe check that the clone polygon bbox equals the expected placement bbox (using `arrayXformPoint` over `arrayShapesOf`).
> 
> Actually a much more robust and testable approach in the implementation: do NOT build a matrix analytically; instead derive it from point triples:
> ```
> const srcPts = world points of the object's source contour (3 non-collinear, e.g. bbox corners on the outer polygon? need actual vertices)
> const dstPts = same 3 vertices after M_world (computed via F0/M_sheet/G with the vertex coordinates)
> matrix = similarityFrom3(srcPts, dstPts)
> ```
> Since M_world is a similarity (rotation + optional reflection), a 3-point fit is exact. Same thing but numerically verified. Either way, include `nestSimilarityFrom3` in core.js + smoke test. Good.
> 
> Also, the clone's `a` anchor: set to cloneAnchorOf semantics = first point of first master (world) at creation. But if we want clones to stay when the master is moved, `a` should be that anchor at creation. Use `{m: matrix, a: anchor}` where anchor = world coords of the master's first point (as `cloneAnchorOf` computes). Note `cloneAnchorOf` is private; plan says reuse or compute.

> Important consistency: `cloneInstanceOffsets` cancels translation delta if anchor moved: `mat = matMul(mat, [1,0,0,1,-ddx,-ddy])`. This keeps the clone at its placed location. Good.

> ### Selection semantics for "loops"
> 
> `loopShapeSelected(loop)` includes the "all points selected" cascade. Use it. Build:
> 1. `selectedLoopList = getLoops().filter(loopShapeSelected)`.
> 2. Sheet = selected green loop OR auto-detected green loop.
> 3. Objects from remaining loops, grouping by containment: compute depth by `pointInPoly(interiorProbe(loop.poly), other.poly)` and area ordering (a loop inside a bigger selected loop = child). Grouping rule:
>    - Find the smallest containing parent for each loop.
>    - Root (even depth): object outer.
>    - Odd depth: attach to its parent object as a hole.
>    - Even depth ≥2: its own object, but the nesting shape must account for being inside the parent's hole. For v1, treat as separate object (it will be nested somewhere else on the sheet) — correct since each copy is cut separately. Hmm, but if it's an island inside a hole, physically it's a separate piece; nesting it separately is right, and the holes stay holes. But then the parent's hole remains; fine.
>    - Also if an inner loop's entities overlap the outer's (shared) → not a separate loop anyway.
> 4. Each object contours: outer poly + descendant hole loops (odd depth) — for collision "holes" list; for output, masters = union of entity ids of outer+holes; clone renders all.
> 
> Wait: clone masters all move rigidly, so the holes stay in place relative to the outer. Correct.
> 
> Edge cases:
> - Loop with `area` tiny (< 1 mm²) → skip with a status note.
> - Sheet loop must be closed; if the green loop is not closed (open green line), error toast "sheet must be a closed loop".
> - Green loop that's also a selected object? Exclude from objects.

> ### Nesting space & sheet polygon
> 
> Sheet polygon in sheet space; computing scanline intervals: for each y, intersections of horizontal line with sheet poly edges; pairs define interior. Reference uses `pts[0]..pts[last]` as a single range, which is only valid for convex-ish sheets. For a non-convex sheet with multiple spans, use proper pairs (`[i],[i+1]`). Deviation noted. Simpler v1: use the sheet's bbox as the sheet, but *also* require part inside the actual polygon (so a non-rectangular sheet works and parts stay inside). The scanline range then uses the polygon intervals (pairs). Good: `sheetSpans(y)` returns sorted pairs.

Since parts are grown by gap/2, require grown part inside the *original* sheet polygon gives at least gap/2 clearance from the edge. Good — no sheet inset needed. Two grown-by-g/2 shapes that don't overlap ⇒ originals are ≥ g apart (assuming outward offset exact). Yes (miter joins may overshoot at sharp corners, giving more clearance — acceptable). But grown polys might overlap only at their grown portions; our collision test on grown polys forbids overlap. However, we should output original geometry; clipping not an issue.

```
/**
 * Optimized Algorithm (Bottom-Left Fill + SAT)
 *
 * NFPOptimized extends NFP and inherits its shared placement loop,
 * spatial hash, lazy-clone tryPlacement and renest/compact logic.
 * The difference vs. the plain NFP ("Grid") algorithm:
 *
 *   1. tryPlacement() adds a small random noise term to the score so
 *      repeated runs (infinite nesting) explore different layouts.
 */
class NFPOptimized extends NFP {
    tryPlacement(variant, px, py, placedParts, placedParts2, sheet, checkchild = true) {
        // Bounds of the translated clone = cached variant bounds + offset.
        // Cheap O(1): getBounds() is cached, so we avoid cloning the variant
        // unless a bbox-overlapping candidate actually requires an exact test.
        const vb = variant.getBounds();
        const bx = vb.x + px;
        const by = vb.y + py;
        const bw = vb.width;
        const bh = vb.height;
        if (!this.hascustomsheet) {
            if (bx < 0 || by < 0 || bx + bw > sheet.width || by + bh > sheet.height) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // Always reset so variant.insideBonus never holds a stale value from a
        // previous candidate, even on the no-candidate fast path.
        variant.insideBonus = 0;
        let insideBonus = 0;
        const cand1 = placedParts ? this._collectCandidates(bx, by, bw, bh, placedParts) : null;
        const cand2 = this._collectCandidates(bx, by, bw, bh, placedParts2);
        if (cand1 !== null || cand2 !== null) {
            // NOTE: polygonsIntersectAt may raise variant.insideBonus as a side
            // effect (variant fits inside a hole), so read it after the checks.
            if (cand1 !== null && this._conflictsWithList(variant, px, py, cand1, true, checkchild)) return null;
            if (cand2 !== null && this._conflictsWithList(variant, px, py, cand2, false, true)) return null;
            insideBonus = variant.insideBonus;
        }

        const heightScore = by + bh * 2;
        const complexityPenalty = variant.paths.length > 1 ? 1000 * GEOM_SCALE : 0;
        // Small random noise breaks ties differently on each run, so the
        // infinite-loop mode keeps exploring and improving the layout.
        const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * GEOM_SCALE * 0.5;
        return (heightScore * 2 + complexityPenalty + noise) - insideBonus;
    }
}

            const flip = this.allowFlip.checked;

            this.dragVariants = [];
            for (const angle of rotations) {
                const v = originalSource.clone();
                if (angle !== 0) v.rotate(angle); else v.align();
                this.dragVariants.push({ part: v, label: `${angle}°` });
                if (flip) {
                    const vf = originalSource.clone();
                    if (angle !== 0) vf.rotate(angle); else vf.align();
                    vf.flip();
                    this.dragVariants.push({ part: vf, label: `${angle}°F` });
                }
            }

            this.dragVariantIndex = 0;
        }

        // Cycle to next variant
        this.dragVariantIndex = (this.dragVariantIndex + 1) % this.dragVariants.length;
        const nextVariant = this.dragVariants[this.dragVariantIndex].part.clone();

        // Position the new variant so its centre aligns with current drag position
        const vBounds = nextVariant.getBounds();
        const targetX = worldPos.x * GEOM_SCALE - vBounds.width / 2;
        const targetY = worldPos.y * GEOM_SCALE - vBounds.height / 2;
        nextVariant.translate(targetX - vBounds.x, targetY - vBounds.y);

        // Replace current part in placedParts with the new variant
        const idx = this.placedParts.indexOf(currentPart);
        if (idx !== -1) {
            nextVariant.color = currentPart.color;
            nextVariant.lcolor = currentPart.lcolor;
            this.placedParts[idx] = nextVariant;
            this.currentSolutionCanvas.parts = this.placedParts;
        }

        return nextVariant;
    }

    readGAParams() {
        const pop = parseInt(this.gaPopSize && this.gaPopSize.value, 10);
        const gen = parseInt(this.gaGenerations && this.gaGenerations.value, 10);
        const mut = parseFloat(this.gaMutation && this.gaMutation.value);
        this.gaParams = {
            popSize: Math.min(50, Math.max(2, pop || 6)),
            generations: Math.min(200, Math.max(1, gen || 5)),
            mutationRate: Math.min(1, Math.max(0, isNaN(mut) ? 0.1 : mut))
        };
    }

    updateGAParamsVisibility() {
        if (!this.gaParamsBox || !this.useNFP2Checkbox) return;
        this.gaParamsBox.style.display = this.useNFP2Checkbox.value === 'ga' ? '' : 'none';
    }

>   let done = false, slice = null;

>   if (done) nestFinish(slice); else { nestUpdateProgress(slice); nestTimer = setTimeout(nestStep, 0); }
> }

function chainPolylines(chains, tol) {
  const pool = chains.map(c => ({ pts: c.pts.slice(), closed: !!c.closed }));
  const near = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) <= tol;

    const cur = pool.shift();
    if (cur.closed) {

    }

    while (grew) {
      grew = false;
      const head = cur.pts[0];
      const tail = cur.pts[cur.pts.length - 1];
      for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) {
        const o = pool[i];
        if (o.closed) continue;
        const a = o.pts[0];
        const b = o.pts[o.pts.length - 1];
        if (near(tail, a)) cur.pts = cur.pts.concat(o.pts.slice(1));
        else if (near(tail, b)) cur.pts = cur.pts.concat(o.pts.slice(0, -1).reverse());
        else if (near(head, b)) cur.pts = o.pts.slice(0, -1).concat(cur.pts);
        else if (near(head, a)) cur.pts = o.pts.slice(1).reverse().concat(cur.pts);

  function bakeContours(ents, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const tol = isFinite(+o.joinTol) && +o.joinTol > 0 ? +o.joinTol : BAKE_JOIN_TOL;
    // Chains only merge inside one colour AND one loop fill: a group is a
    // container and every object keeps its colour and its fill.
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const e of ents || []) {
      const fill = (e.fill === 'gray' || e.fill === 'yellow') ? e.fill : '';
      const key = (colorOf(e) || '') + '|' + fill;
      let bucket = groups.get(key);
      if (!bucket) groups.set(key, bucket = { color: colorOf(e) || '', fill: fill || null, chains: [] });
      for (const pl of entityWorldPolylines(e)) {
        if (pl && pl.pts && pl.pts.length >= 2) bucket.chains.push(pl);
      }
    }
    const merged = [];
    for (const group of groups.values()) {
      for (const c of chainPolylines(group.chains, tol)) {
        c.color = group.color;
        c.fill = group.fill;
        merged.push(c);
      }

      const a = c.pts[0];
      const b = c.pts[c.pts.length - 1];
      if (Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y) <= tol) c.pts.pop();
    }
    return { contours: normalizeWinding(merged), curves: o.keepCurve ? collectCurveSources(ents) : null };

Ringkasan keputusan (TL;DR)\n\n| Topik | Keputusan |\n| --- | --- |\n| Tempat engine | file baru `nest/engine.js`, classic script, murni (tanpa DOM), `window.MiniSketchNest` + `module.exports` |\n| Background | **tanpa Web Worker** (app dibuka dari `file://`, worker file:// diblokir). Generator + scheduler time-slice `setTimeout(0)`, budget ~12 ms/slice |\n| Ruang kerja algoritma | *sheet space* Y-down (origin = pojok kiri-atas bbox loop hijau), lalu dikonjugasi balik ke world Y-up lewat matrix |\n| Output | **clone** (`type:'array', kind:'clone'`), masters = entity loop objek (outer + lubang), instances = matrix penempatan |\n| Master | tidak pernah digeser/diubah; clone hanya membaca geometri master |\n| Compound loop | 1 objek = 1 loop outer + loop-loop lubang di dalamnya (depth genap/ganjil) |\n| Sheet | loop yang **semua entity-nya** berwarna `#00ff00`; auto-deteksi kalau tepat satu, kalau lebih harus dipilih |\n| Hasil | blok hasil otomatis diletakkan di kanan sheet, `GAP = 10 mm`; yang tidak muat ditumpuk ke kanan blok hasil |\n| Gap part | offset tiap part keluar `gap/2` memakai `offsetChains` (Clipper) yang sudah ada, penempatan pakai poly yang sudah digemukkan, output pakai geometri asli |\n| Undo | satu langkah undo untuk seluruh penempatan (dan satu langkah untuk penggantian hasil lama) |\n| Default parameter | rotasi `0,90,180,270`, flip off, grid 4 mm, populasi 6, generasi 5, mutasi 0.1 (sama dengan referensi) |\n| Nesting server lama | **tidak disentuh** (fitur terpisah, tetap ada) |\n| Konfigurasi yang diubah | `node testing/nesting_probe.js` ditambahkan ke allowlist `.commandcode/settings.json` |\n\nAlasan inti memilih engine referensi apa adanya: hasilnya sudah dipakai owner\nsehari-hari, dan bentuk datanya (polygon + holes + matrix) cocok dengan clone\nMiniSketch. Yang saya ubah hanya hal-hal yang di MiniSketch berbeda: satuan mm\n(bukan `GEOM_SCALE = 1000`), tidak ada kanvas preview, dan eksekusi harus\nkooperatif karena tidak ada worker.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Tujuan & non-tujuan\n\n### Tujuan\n\n1. Panel **Nesting** di sidebar kanan, sejajar panel lain (Layers, Parts, Array, …).\n2. Owner memilih loop di kanvas → panel menampungnya sebagai **objek** (compound\n   loop = 1 objek). Satu loop hijau = **lembar/sheet**.\n3. Tombol **Nest** menjalankan GA + NFP2 lokal, dengan progress, estimasi sisa,\n   dan **Stop** yang benar-benar menghentikan tanpa merusak dokumen.\n4. Hasil terbaik langsung ditempatkan sebagai **clone** di kanvas: blok hasil di\n   kanan sheet, sisa yang tidak muat di kanan blok hasil.\n5. Hasil bisa diulang (re-nest) dan di-undo sebagai satu langkah.\n\n### Non-tujuan (v1, sengaja tidak dikerjakan)\n\n- Qty per objek (1 objek = 1 salinan). Struktur `instances` sudah siap untuk qty\n  nanti, tapi UI/GA-nya belum.\n- Multi-sheet, sheet sisa (remnant), nesting bertahap/`renest` seperti referensi.\n- Kerf/tool-radius compensation. `gap` adalah jarak antar-part, bukan kompensasi\n  radius pahat.\n- Mengganti/menghapus fitur nesting server KaryaCNC yang sudah ada (`cmdNest`).\n- Menambah dukungan `text`/`art`/`image`/`part` sebagai objek nesting (hanya loop).\n- Preview layout sebelum commit, drag-and-drop part di preview.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Fakta repo yang jadi dasar plan\n\n- Static app, tanpa build, tanpa ES module, dibuka dari `file://`. Script dimuat\n  berurutan di `index.html:750-768`: `tools/*`, `ai/chat.js`, `core.js`, `app.js`.\n- `app.js` satu IIFE raksasa (~26.5k baris). `core.js` murni + bisa di-`require`\n  di Node dan diuji `tests/smoke.js`.\n- Loop: `getLoops()` (`app.js:8606`) → `{ poly, area, steps, circle?, splineEntity? }`,\n  `poly` sudah titik world mm (Y-up). Klik di dalam loop memilih entity loop\n  (`applyLoopClick`, `app.js:18809`); `loopShapeSelected` (`app.js:7053`) =\n  semua entity loop terseleksi; `loopEntities` (`app.js:7037`).\n- Clone: `kind:'clone'`, `masters:[ids]`, `instances:[{m:[a,b,c,d,e,f], a:[x,y]}]`\n  (`cmdClone` `app.js:11453`, `cloneInstanceOffsets` `11403`,\n  `cloneAnchorOf` `11390`, `arrayShapesOf` `11629`, `arrayEnsureShapes` `11686`).\n  Save/load clone instances sudah didukung (`app.js:25093-25103`).\n- Offset + Clipper: `offsetChains(chains, dist, opts)` (`app.js:12705`) sudah\n  menormalisasi winding (island tumbuh, hole menyusut) lewat `tools/clipper.js`.\n- Polygon helpers: `pointInPoly` (`core.js:1574`), `signedAreaPts` (`1584`),\n  `interiorProbe` (`1594`), `chainPolylines` (`1643`), `normalizeWinding` (`1619`),\n  `matMul` (`core.js:54`), `matApply` (`core.js:65`).\n- Flatten akurat: `pathChainsOf(ents, tol)` (`app.js:11993`) — line/spline/arc/circle\n  di-flatten adaptif (default tol 0.05 mm).\n- Warna: `#00ff00` = \"Mark (green)\" di `COLORS` (`app.js:49`). Guide milik array\n  dikecualikan lewat `ownedGuideIds` (`app.js:25657`).\n- `updateUI()` (`app.js:17536`) adalah satu-satunya tempat daftar panel di-refresh\n  (`updatePartsList`, `updateArrayList`, …). Panel baru harus nempel di sini.\n- Settings disimpan di `localStorage` per-key (lihat pola `minisketch.*`), undo\n  lewat `pushHistory()` (`app.js:2305`) + `commit()` (`app.js:2612`).\n- `agents.md`: UI tidak boleh dites sendiri oleh agent; verifikasi browser milik\n  owner. Karena itu §12 memuat resep tes presisi, bukan klaim \"sudah dites\".\n\n---\n\n## 3. UX panel\n\n### 3.1 Penempatan di sidebar\n\nSisipkan `<section class=\"panel\">` baru di `index.html` setelah section Tools\n(± baris 352, sebelum panel Layers), jadi urutannya: Tools → **Nesting** → Layers → …\n\n```\n┌ Nesting ────────────────────────────────┐\n│ Sheet (green loop)                      │\n│   ▢ 300 × 200 mm        [Pick] [Clear]  │\n│   (300 × 200 · 4 sudut · layer 1)       │\n│                                         │\n│ Objects (4)              [Add] [Clear]  │\n│   ▸ Rect 100×60    (1 loop)             │\n│   ▸ Ring 80×80     (2 loops, 1 hole)    │\n│   ▸ L-bracket      (1 loop, 6 pts)      │\n│   ▸ Plate 120×90   (3 loops, 2 holes)   │\n│   (+ 2 lebih)                           │\n│                                         │\n│ Gap (mm)        [ 2 ]                   │\n│ Rotation        [0,90,180,270      ▾]   │\n│ Allow flip      [ ]                     │\n│ Quality         [Normal ▾]              │\n│ ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓░░░░░░  62%   eval 19/31       │\n│ Placed 3/4 · block 312×198 mm           │\n│ [ ▶ Nest ]  [ ■ Stop ]  [ Clear result ]│\n└─────────────────────────────────────────┘\n```\n\nTombol **Add** mengambil dari seleksi kanvas (bukan dari daftar loop global) supaya\nowner tetap mengontrol apa yang masuk. **Sheet ▢ Pick** mengambil loop hijau yang\nsedang terseleksi; kalau tidak ada yang terseleksi, ambil satu-satunya loop hijau\ndi dokumen.\n\n### 3.2 Alur\n\n```\npilih loop di kanvas ──► Add ──► daftar Objects\ngambar/ pilih loop hijau ──► Pick ──► Sheet\n[ ▶ Nest ] ──► validasi ──► job jalan (progress) ──► hasil ──► clone di kanvas\n                     │\n                     └─► [ ■ Stop ] ──► dokumen tidak berubah, panel simpan status\n```\n\n- Satu objek hanya boleh masuk sekali (kunci = daftar entity id yang diurutkan).\n  Menambah objek yang sudah ada diabaikan + toast.\n- Kalau loop hijau yang dipilih ternyata objek (bukan sheet), tolak dengan pesan.\n- Panel mengingat daftar objek + sheet + setting antar sesi\n  (`localStorage['minisketch.nest.v1']`), **tapi tidak** mengingat hasil.\n  Saat dokumen dibuka lagi, objek yang entity-nya hilang dibuang diam-diam\n  (dan dihitung di status: \"2 objek dibuang, entity hilang\").\n- Selama job jalan: tombol Nest disabled, Stop aktif, daftar Object/Sheet\n  read-only (tapi kanvas tetap bisa dipakai — lihat §7.4).\n\n### 3.3 Status yang harus terbaca (untuk verifikasi owner)\n\nSetelah selesai, satu baris status:\n\n```\nPlaced 18/20 · block 312×198 mm · 71% · 31 evals · 8.4 s\n```\n\n- `Placed k/n` — berapa objek masuk sheet.\n- `block W×H` — bbox blok hasil (mm, world).\n- `%` — utilisasi = luas asli objek terpasang / luas bbox blok.\n- `evals` — jumlah evaluasi GA yang selesai (populasi × generasi + 1 baseline).\n- `s` — wall clock job.\n\nKalau 0 yang muat: `Placed 0/4 · semua tidak muat · blok di kanan sheet`.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Loop → objek, dan sheet\n\n### 4.1 Kandidat loop\n\nHanya loop yang **seluruh entity-nya** lolos `loopShapeSelected(loop)` yang\ndipertimbangkan. Guide milik array dibuang (`ownedGuideIds()`), loop yang semua\nentity-nya hijau dipisahkan sebagai kandidat sheet.\n\n### 4.2 Compound loop = satu objek\n\nUntuk dua loop `a`, `b` di layer yang sama, `a` **di dalam** `b` bila\n`pointInPoly(interiorProbe(a.poly), b.poly)` benar. Hitung `depth(loop)` = jumlah\nloop lain yang memuat loop itu (dibatasi ke layer yang sama, dan hanya di antara\nkandidat objek).\n\n- `depth` genap → **objek** (outer).\n- `depth` ganjil → **lubang** milik objek genap terdekat yang memuatnya\n  (container dengan area terkecil).\n\n```\nobjek = { key, layer, outer: loop, holes: [loop...], entityIds: [...] }\n```\n\nKonsekuensi yang harus disadari (dan ditampilkan di panel: \"2 loops, 1 hole\"):\nkalau owner menggambar dua kotak yang salah satunya di dalam yang lain, keduanya\notomatis jadi satu objek berlubang — itu memang aturan yang diminta.\n\nKalau loop hijau ikut terseleksi, ia **tidak** masuk objek; ia jadi sheet.\n\n### 4.3 Sheet\n\nSheet = loop yang semua entity-nya berwarna `#00ff00` dan bukan guide milik array.\n\nAturan pemilihan:\n\n1. Kalau ada loop hijau yang terseleksi persis satu → itu sheet-nya.\n2. Kalau tidak ada yang terseleksi dan di dokumen ada tepat satu loop hijau → auto.\n3. Kalau lebih dari satu → panel minta owner memilih satu (\"2 green loops: pilih\n   satu lalu tekan Pick\"). Tidak menebak, karena salah sheet = salah hasil.\n4. Sheet boleh berlubang (green loop di dalam green loop): ikut dipakai sebagai\n   obstacle di engine (`sheet.holes`), jadi part tidak akan ditaruh di lubang sheet.\n\nSheet harus tertutup (`loop` memang hanya loop tertutup). Kalau tidak ada loop\nhijau sama sekali: `Nest` disabled + hint \"gambar loop hijau sebagai lembar\".\n\n### 4.4 Geometri objek (presisi)\n\n`loop.poly` dari `getLoops()` **tidak dipakai langsung**: untuk circle jumlah\ntitiknya tetap 72 (kasar untuk Ø besar), dan poly itu hasil sampling tampilan.\nSebagai gantinya, untuk tiap loop:\n\n```js\nconst ents = loopEntities(loop).filter(e => !owned.has(+e.id));\nconst chains = chainPolylines(pathChainsOf(ents, 0.05), JOIN_TOL);\n// pilih chain tertutup yang cocok: |area - loop.area| terkecil\nconst pts = normalizeClosed(rdpSimplify(pick.pts, 0.02));   // ~0.02 mm\n```\n\n- `pathChainsOf(..., 0.05)` memakai flattener yang sama dengan jalur CNC\n  (spline adaptif, arc via cubic, circle via cubic) → deviasi < 0.05 mm.\n- `chainPolylines` menyambung segmen entity menjadi satu kontur; kalau loop\n  berbagi entity dengan loop lain, ada >1 kandidat → pilih yang areanya paling\n  dekat dengan `loop.area`.\n- `rdpSimplify(pts, 0.02)` hanya untuk meringankan collision test; geometri\n  output tetap master asli, jadi tidak ada perubahan bentuk yang terlihat.\n- `normalizeWinding` dipakai supaya outer CCW / hole CW di sheet space.\n\nBatas aman: kalau hasil simplify menurunkan luas > 0.5%, jangan simplify.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Ruang koordinat & matrix\n\n### 5.1 Tiga ruang\n\n| Ruang | Sumbu Y | Isi |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| **World** (dokumen MiniSketch) | naik | semua entity, sheet, output clone |\n| **Sheet space** | turun | kerja engine: origin = (sheet.bbox.minX, sheet.bbox.maxY) |\n| Output | naik | world, blok hasil di kanan sheet |\n\nKonjugasi world → sheet space (`F0`) dan sheet space → output world (`G`):\n\n```\nF0 = [1, 0, 0, -1, -sx0, sy1]      // (x, y) -> (x - sx0, sy1 - y)\nG  = [1, 0, 0, -1, outX, sy1]      // (u, v) -> (outX + u, sy1 - v)\noutX = max(sheet.bbox.maxX, masters.bbox.maxX) + GAP     // GAP = 10 mm\n```\n\n`max(...)` dengan bbox master mencegah hasil menimpa loop sumber kalau owner\nsudah menggambar objek di kanan sheet.\n\nPerhatikan `G ∘ F0` = translasi `(outX - sx0, 0)`: konjugasi ini konsisten dan\ntidak membalik geometri (dua kali flip Y).\n\n### 5.2 Matrix penempatan\n\nEngine menyimpan, per objek, transform pra-varian:\n\n```\nmPre = T(align) · R(angle) · M(flip)\n```\n\n- `M(flip)` = `[1,0,0,-1,0,2*cy]` (cermin terhadap garis horizontal melalui\n  center bbox sumber; hanya kalau flip aktif).\n- `R(angle)` = `[cos, sin, -sin, cos, 0, 0]` (konvensi `matApply`/`matMul` app).\n- `T(align)` = `[1,0,0,1,ax,ay]`, `(ax, ay) = -bboxMin(mPre.sebelum align)` →\n  bbox varian mulai di (0,0).\n\nPenempatan `(dx, dy)` adalah pojok kiri-atas bbox varian di sheet space:\n\n```\nmSheet = T(dx, dy) · mPre\nmWorld = G · mSheet · F0          // inilah `instances[i].m`\n```\n\n`mWorld` adalah similarity (rotasi/mirror + translasi), jadi seluruh master\n(outer + lubang) ikut kaku.\n\n### 5.3 Contoh angka yang bisa dicek\n\nSheet world: `x 100..400`, `y 50..250` → `sx0 = 100`, `sy1 = 250`, `outX = 410`.\nObjek: kotak 100×60 world `(150,60)-(250,120)`.\n\n- `F0` → `(50,190)-(150,130)` di sheet space, bbox `x 50..150, y 130..190`.\n- Varian angle 0, tanpa flip: `align = (-50,-130)`, `mPre = [1,0,0,1,-50,-130]`.\n- Penempatan hasil GA yang sudah dinormalisasi: `(dx, dy) = (0, 0)`.\n- `mWorld = [1, 0, 0, 1, 260, 130]`.\n- Cek: `(150,60) → (410,190)`, `(250,120) → (510,250)`.\n\nJadi blok hasil mulai tepat 10 mm di kanan sheet (`410`) dan menempel di garis\natas sheet (`y = 250`). Angka ini dipakai sebagai test case probe (§12.1 #11).\n\n### 5.4 Normalisasi blok\n\nSetelah decode terbaik, semua placement digeser `(-bounds.x, -bounds.y)` supaya\nblok mulai di origin output (tidak ada ruang mati di kiri/atas karena sheet besar).\n`mWorld` dihitung dari `dx,dy` yang sudah digeser.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Engine: port GA + NFP2\n\n### 6.1 Peta fungsi referensi → `nest/engine.js`\n\n| Referensi (`nestjs2/frontend/js`) | Port | Catatan |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| `NFP2SpatialHash` (`nfp2.js`) | `SpatialHash` | cell `max(50, step*5)`, query bbox |\n| `NFP2.findBestNFPPlacement` | `*findBestPlacement(obj, variant)` | scanline + score prune + vertex pass |\n| `NFP2.getCandidatePositions` | `vertexCandidates(variant, placed)` | 6 titik acuan × vertex |\n| `NFP2.checkCollisions` | `collides(placed, variant, x, y)` | AABB → poly → sheet |\n| `NFP2.calculateTotalBounds` | `boundsOf(placed)` | |\n| `NFP2.compactSolution` | — | tidak perlu (tidak ada renest) |\n| `NFPGA.findBestPosition` (`nfp_ga.js`) | `*gaSearch(ctx)` | elitism 2, OX, mutasi |\n| `NFPGA._evaluate` | `*decode(ctx, chromosome)` | tanpa sheet clone, tanpa `fixed` |\n| `NFPGA._createChromosome` | `createChromosome()` | permutation + rotation gene |\n| `NFPGA._crossover` | `oxCrossover(a, b)` | OX + rotation gene dari parent A |\n| `NFPGA._mutate` | `mutate(c)` | swap 2 gen + ganti rotasi |\n| `main.js runNesting` | `run(input, opts)` | generator, bukan worker |\n\nYang **tidak** diport: `nfp.js` / `nfp_optimized.js` (varian \"Grid\"/noise),\n`renest`, `multiCPU`, preview kanvas, preset file, infinite loop.\n\n### 6.2 Formula yang dipertahankan\n\n```\nscore(x, y, variant) = (y + h * 2) * 2 + x * 0.1 + penalty\npenalty              = variant.holes > 0 ? 500 : 0        // mm², hanya tie-break\nscore               -= insideBonus                        // 5000 kalau masuk lubang\n```\n\n- Preferensi: **atas dulu, lalu kiri** (sheet space Y-down).\n- Early break per baris: `if (best && y > H/3) break` — kalau sudah ada tempat\n  bagus di sepertiga atas, tidak perlu memindai sisa sheet.\n- Prune per kolom: `if (score > bestScore + 100) break` (score naik monoton\n  terhadap x).\n- Fitness GA:\n\n```\nfitness = bounds(placed).w * bounds(placed).h\n        + Σ (bboxArea(obj) untuk setiap objek yang tidak muat)\n```\n\n  kecil = lebih baik. Baseline (urutan `longest side²` desc, rotasi 0) selalu\n  jadi individu pertama, jadi hasil GA **tidak mungkin lebih buruk** dari urutan\n  naif itu.\n- Elitism 2; total evaluasi = `pop * gens + 1`.\n- Mutasi: `mutationRate` (0.1) → 30% swap dua gen, 30% ganti satu gen rotasi,\n  40% keduanya (persis pola referensi).\n\n### 6.3 Deviasi yang disengaja (dan alasannya)\n\n1. **Satuan mm, bukan `GEOM_SCALE = 1000`.** Semua toleransi (`0.001 mm`) dan\n   `penalty`/`insideBonus` diskalakan. Ini menghilangkan seluruh `/1000` di\n   referensi dan membuat probe bisa membandingkan angka mm langsung.\n2. **Sheet sebagai polygon, bukan kotak.** `findBestPlacement` memakai\n   `freeSpansAtY(y)`: interval bebas = span sheet dikurangi interval part yang\n   sudah terpasang. Kelebihan vs referensi:\n   - sheet berlubang / tidak konveks ditangani benar;\n   - referensi `x = ceil(intersections[i+1])` mengasumsikan tiap part memberi\n     tepat 2 perpotongan dan pasangan bersebelahan — rapuh kalau ada >2 objek\n     sebaris. Span subtraction selalu benar.\n3. **`insideBonus` dikembalikan, bukan disimpan di objek varian.** Referensi\n   menaruh `variant.insideBonus` lalu membacanya setelah pengecekan; nilai basi\n   dari kandidat sebelumnya bisa terbawa. Port mengembalikan\n   `{hit, bonus}` per kandidat.\n4. **Flip benar-benar diimplementasikan.** Di referensi `setAllowFlip` tidak\n   pernah dipakai `NFP2` (flip hanya hidup di drag-rotate). Di sini flip\n   menambah varian.\n5. **Tanpa `complexityPenalty = 1000 * GEOM_SCALE`;** diganti `500 mm²` kecil\n   supaya tidak mendominasi score yang kini dalam mm.\n6. **Normalisasi blok** (§5.4), tidak ada di referensi.\n7. **Tanpa noise acak di score.** Noise hanya berguna untuk infinite nesting;\n   di sini randomness datang dari populasi/mutasi.\n8. **Deadline per decode** (§7.3), tidak ada di referensi (worker tidak perlu).\n\n### 6.4 Pseudocode inti\n\n```js\n// generator, yield progress tiap 512 uji\nfunction* findBestPlacement(ctx, obj, variant) {\n  let best = null, bestScore = Infinity, tests = 0;\n  const { w, h } = variant.bbox;\n  for (let y = 0; y + h <= ctx.sheetH; y += ctx.step) {\n    for (const [x0, x1] of freeSpansAtY(ctx, y)) {\n      for (let x = x0; x + w <= x1; x += ctx.step) {\n        const score = baseScore(x, y, variant);\n        if (best && score > bestScore + 100) break;\n        const r = collides(ctx, variant, x, y);\n        if (!r.hit) {\n          const s = score - r.bonus;\n          if (s < bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = { x, y }; }\n          if (r.bonus > 5000) return best;      // pas masuk lubang: sudah optimal\n        }\n        if ((++tests & 511) === 0) yield { phase: 'place', tests };\n      }\n    }\n    if (best && y > ctx.sheetH / 3) break;\n  }\n  // pass presisi: tempelkan ke vertex part yang sudah ada\n  for (const cand of vertexCandidates(ctx, variant)) {\n    const r = collides(ctx, variant, cand.x, cand.y);\n    if (!r.hit) {\n      const s = baseScore(cand.x, cand.y, variant) - r.bonus;\n      if (s < bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = cand; }\n    }\n    if ((++tests & 511) === 0) yield { phase: 'vertex', tests };\n  }\n  return best;\n}\n\nfunction* decode(ctx, chromosome) {\n  const placed = [], hash = new SpatialHash(ctx.step);\n  let unplacedArea = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < chromosome.order.length; i++) {\n    const obj = ctx.objects[chromosome.order[i]];\n    const variant = obj.variants[chromosome.rot[i] % obj.variants.length];\n    if (ctx.deadline && now() > ctx.deadline) { unplacedArea += obj.area; continue; }\n    const at = yield* findBestPlacement(ctx, obj, variant);\n    if (!at) { unplacedArea += obj.area; continue; }\n    placed.push({ obj, variant, x: at.x, y: at.y });\n    hash.insert(at.x, at.y, variant.bbox.w, variant.bbox.h, placed.length - 1);\n  }\n  const b = boundsOf(placed);\n  const area = placed.length ? b.w * b.h + unplacedArea : unplacedArea + ctx.sheetArea;\n  return { placed, area, bbox: b };\n}\n```\n\n### 6.5 Collision\n\nUrutan cek (yang murah dulu):\n\n1. bbox varian di dalam bbox sheet? kalau tidak → hit.\n2. **sheet containment**: semua vertex varian di dalam `sheet.outline` dan tidak\n   ada edge varian yang memotong edge sheet (atau edge lubang sheet) → lanjut.\n   Ini yang membuat sheet non-konveks benar.\n3. query `SpatialHash` dengan bbox varian; untuk tiap kandidat:\n   `polysOverlap(varian shifted, placed.poly)` → hit.\n4. **lubang**: kalau varian **seluruhnya** di dalam salah satu hole part yang\n   sudah terpasang → bukan hit, `bonus = 5000` (hemat bahan; mengikuti referensi,\n   termasuk batasannya: hanya lubang, bukan \"di dalam part\").\n\n`polysOverlap(a, b)`: bbox reject dulu, lalu (i) ada vertex a di dalam b,\n(ii) ada vertex b di dalam a, (iii) ada pasangan edge yang berpotongan\n(strict, tidak menghitung sentuhan). Toleransi geometri `0.001 mm`; jarak nyata\nantar-part dijamin oleh penggemukan `gap/2` (§6.6).\n\n### 6.6 Gap\n\n`gap` tidak dihitung saat collision (mahal dan rawan). Cara yang sama dengan\nreferensi: tiap part **digemukkan** `gap/2` sekali di awal.\n\n```\ngrown = offsetChains([{pts: outer, closed:true}, ...holes], gap/2)\n```\n\n`offsetChains` (Clipper) sudah menangani island vs hole (outer tumbuh, hole\nmenyusut) sehingga inner offset ring tetap benar. Yang dipakai di engine:\n`grown[0]` sebagai poly collision, `grown[1..]` sebagai hole. Geometri output\ntetap outer/hole asli → gap terlihat sebagai celah, bukan perubahan bentuk.\n\nKarena poly di-simplify 0.02 mm, clearance efektif = `gap - 0.04 mm`. Aman untuk\n`gap ≥ 0.5`. Kalau `gap = 0`, clearance bisa sedikit negatif (tumpang tindih\n0.02 mm) — status panel memperingatkan `gap 0: part bisa bersinggungan`.\n\n### 6.7 Varian\n\n`obj.variants` dibangun sekali per job:\n\n```\nangles = parseRotation(opts.rotation)   // \"0,90,180,270\" -> [0,90,180,270]\nvars = []\nfor (a of angles) for (f of (opts.flip ? [false, true] : [false])) {\n  const m = composePre(outer, holes, a, f);   // mPre + bbox + poly\n  vars.push({ m, bbox, poly: grownOuter, holes: grownHoles, angle: a, flip: f });\n}\n```\n\nKalau `angles` kosong / tidak valid → `[0]`. Varian dengan bbox > sheet dibuang\nlebih awal (tidak mungkin muat).\n\n---\n\n## 7. Eksekusi background\n\n### 7.1 Kenapa bukan Web Worker\n\nApp dibuka dari `file://`. `new Worker('nest/worker.js')` gagal di Chrome\n(`file://` tidak boleh memuat worker), dan fallback Blob worker juga diblokir\ndi sebagian konfigurasi. Solusi yang pasti jalan di semua cara buka file:\n**generator + scheduler di main thread**, dipecah per ~12 ms. Ini bukan\n\"background\" dalam arti thread terpisah, tapi dari sisi UX sama: UI tetap\nmerespons klik/pan, progress jalan, Stop instan.\n\nKalau nanti app disajikan lewat `http://` (mis. `python -m http.server`), worker\nbisa ditambahkan tanpa mengubah engine (engine murni, tidak menyentuh DOM).\n\n### 7.2 Scheduler\n\n```js\nlet nestRun = null;   // { job, stop, t0, lastPaint, totalEvals }\n\nfunction nestStep() {\n  if (!nestRun) return;\n  if (nestRun.stop) return nestAbort();\n  const t = performance.now();\n  let done = false, msg = null;\n  try {\n    while (performance.now() - t < 12) {\n      const s = nestRun.job.next();\n      if (s.done) { done = true; msg = s.value; break; }\n      msg = s.value;\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error('[nest] crash', err);\n    toast('Nesting gagal: ' + err.message);\n    return nestAbort();\n  }\n  if (done) return nestFinish(msg);\n  nestPaint(msg);                        // throttle: >=1% atau >=100 ms\n  nestRun.timer = setTimeout(nestStep, 0);\n}\n```\n\n- `setTimeout(0)` (bukan `requestAnimationFrame`) supaya tetap maju saat tab\n  tidak aktif (rAF berhenti total di tab background).\n- Generator yield tiap 512 uji collision / 1 part / 1 evaluasi, jadi satu slice\n  tidak bisa jauh melewati 12 ms.\n- `performance.now()` untuk statistik; jangan pakai `Date.now()` (clock bisa\n  melompat).\n\n### 7.3 Deadline & budget\n\n- `opts.deadline = t0 + budgetMs` (Fast 8 s, Normal 30 s, Thorough 120 s).\n- Deadline diperiksa **per objek** di `decode` (bukan per kandidat): kalau lewat,\n  sisa objek dihitung unplaced → decode tetap selesai dengan hasil valid.\n- Setelah deadline, `gaSearch` menyelesaikan evaluasi yang sedang jalan lalu\n  berhenti; hasil = individu terbaik yang **sudah selesai** dievaluasi.\n- Jadi job selalu berakhir dengan solusi utuh (tidak ada layout separuh jadi),\n  dan paling lambat overshoot satu evaluasi.\n- `maxCandidateTests` per part (default 60 000) sebagai jaring pengaman untuk\n  sheet raksasa; kalau tercapai, part dianggap tidak muat di kandidat itu.\n\n### 7.4 Interaksi selama job\n\n- Kanvas tetap bisa di-pan/zoom. Kalau owner mengubah geometri master/sheet saat\n  job jalan: input sudah **snapshot** (polygon + matrix anchor diambil di awal),\n  jadi hasil tetap konsisten. Saat finish, entity yang sudah hilang dilewati\n  (+ toast \"1 objek dilewati: entity sudah dihapus\").\n- `anchor` untuk `instances[i].a` diambil dari kondisi **awal** job, sehingga\n  kalau master sempat digeser, clone tetap mendarat di tempat yang direncanakan.\n- Menjalankan job baru saat job lama jalan tidak mungkin (tombol disabled).\n\n### 7.5 Progress\n\n```\nprogress = (evalsDone + placedSoFar / objectCount) / totalEvals\n```\n\n- `evalsDone` = evaluasi selesai (baseline + tiap individu non-elit).\n- Bar + teks `eval n/m`, `Placed k/n` (dari decode yang sedang jalan), dan\n  `best` (fitness terbaik sejauh ini) supaya owner melihat ada kemajuan.\n- Progress hanya naik (monotonic); reset 0 saat job baru.\n\n---\n\n## 8. Output: clone, penempatan, unplaced\n\n### 8.1 Satu clone per objek\n\nUntuk tiap objek dibuat **satu** entity clone berisi seluruh instance objek itu\n(biasanya 1; kalau tidak muat, 1 instance unplaced):\n\n```js\n{\n  id: newId(),\n  type: 'array',\n  kind: 'clone',\n  params: { origin: 'nest', run: 3 },     // penanda hasil nesting\n  color: colorOf(masterPertama),\n  layer: layerMaster,\n  masters: obj.entityIds,                  // outer + holes, urut stabil\n  instances: [\n    { m: [1,0,0,1,260,130], a: [150,60] }  // a = anchor master saat job mulai\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n- `masters` = entity loop outer + semua loop lubang. Urutan diambil dari\n  `obj.entityIds` yang diurutkan naik supaya deterministik (save/load & undo rapi).\n- `a` = titik pertama master (`cloneAnchorOf` memakai `entityPointIds`), nilainya\n  dari snapshot awal. Ini yang membuat clone \"tinggal di tempat\" saat master\n  digeser (`cloneInstanceOffsets` membatalkan translasi anchor).\n- `color`/`layer` hanya untuk pewarnaan array di daftar; geometri tetap mengikuti\n  master (`arrayShapesOf`).\n- Save/load: `instances` + `a` sudah diserialisasi (`app.js:25093-25103`), jadi\n  hasil nesting bertahan setelah simpan/buka.\n\n### 8.2 Penempatan hasil\n\n```\nGAP = 10 mm\noutX  = max(sheet.bbox.maxX, masters.bbox.maxX) + GAP\noutTop = sheet.bbox.maxY            // blok mulai dari garis atas sheet\n```\n\n- Blok hasil = bbox placement yang sudah dinormalisasi (§5.4) → mulai di\n  `(outX, outTop)`.\n- Tidak muat: satu kolom di kanan blok, mulai dari atas blok, jarak 10 mm:\n\n```\ncursorX = block.w + GAP        // relatif sheet space\ncursorY = 0\nfor (obj of unplaced) {\n  mSheet = T(cursorX - srcBBox.minX, cursorY - srcBBox.minY) · mPre(angle 0)\n  cursorY += srcBBox.h + GAP\n}\n```\n\n  Hasilnya: tumpukan vertikal di kanan blok, tidak menimpa blok, tidak menimpa\n  sheet. (Kalau owner ingin horizontal, cukup ubah satu baris — dicatat di §13.)\n\n### 8.3 Commit & undo\n\n- Semua clone dibuat dalam **satu** `pushHistory()` + `commit()`.\n- Kalau ada hasil lama (`nestPanel.lastCloneIds`), hasil itu dihapus **dalam\n  langkah undo yang sama** (push sekali, hapus lama, buat baru, commit). Jadi\n  satu Ctrl+Z mengembalikan keadaan sebelum Nest terakhir.\n- Setelah commit: `ui.selection` = id clone baru, `render()` lewat `commit()`,\n  status panel diisi (§3.3), `geometryEpoch` naik otomatis (clone di-rebuild).\n- Kalau hasil kosong (0 placement), tetap buat clone unplaced supaya owner\n  melihat objeknya tidak hilang — tapi kalau **semua** unplaced, jangan pindahkan\n  apa pun; cukup status \"semua tidak muat, tidak ada yang ditempatkan\"\n  (menghindari tumpukan sia-sia di kanan sheet). Ini keputusan yang bisa\n  dibalik (§13).\n\n### 8.4 Kenapa clone, bukan copy entity\n\n- Master tetap di tempatnya (owner tidak kehilangan gambar asli).\n- Edit master (geser, ubah panjang, ganti radius) langsung terlihat di semua\n  salinan → owner bisa memperbaiki part setelah nesting.\n- Satu entity per objek = dokumen ringan: 200 objek × 1 matrix, bukan 200 × 40\n  entity hasil copy. Ini penting karena app ini sudah berat di dokumen besar.\n- CNC/export sudah memahami clone (`arrayInstancePolylines`, `cncShapesOf`).\n\nRisiko yang diterima: clone tidak bisa diedit per-instance (harus edit master\natau \"bake\"/explode dulu). Itu konsisten dengan cara kerja fitur clone yang ada.\n"
}

Kasus:\n\n1. **spanSubtract / freeSpansAtY**: sheet L (non-konveks), y di bagian kosong →\n   0 span; y yang memotong dua kaki → 2 span; setelah satu part terpasang di\n   kaki kiri → span kiri menyempit, span kanan utuh.\n2. **polysOverlap**: bersentuhan tepi → false; berpotongan → true; satu di dalam\n   yang lain → true; terpisah → false.\n3. **pointInPoly / edgeCross**: titik di lubang → false; edge yang menembus\n   lubang → terdeteksi.\n4. **buildVariants**: kotak 100×60 dengan 4 rotasi → bbox {100×60, 60×100,\n   100×60, 60×100}; flip → bbox sama tapi tanda sumbu Y terbalik (cek satu\n   vertex); semua bbox mulai di (0,0).\n5. **Placement dasar**: satu kotak 100×60 di sheet 300×200, step 4 → `dx=0`,\n   `dy=0` (pojok kiri-atas sheet space).\n6. **Tidak overlap**: 4 kotak hasil satu decode → setiap pasangan `polysOverlap`\n   false, dan semua vertex di dalam sheet.\n7. **Lubang**: sheet 300×300, ring 200×200 dengan lubang 100×100, part 80×80 →\n   part masuk lubang (`bonus`), dan hasilnya berada di dalam lubang (cek\n   `pointInPoly`).\n8. **Tidak muat**: part 400×400 di sheet 300×200 → masuk `unplaced`, bukan\n   crash, dan `placements` kosong.\n9. **GA ≥ baseline**: 8 objek acak (seed 1) → `fitness(best) <= fitness(baseline)`\n   (baseline selalu jadi individu pertama) dan `best.placed >= baseline.placed`.\n10. **Determinisme**: `seed: 7` dua kali → `m` identik; `seed: 8` → layout boleh\n    beda tapi tetap valid (no overlap, semua di dalam sheet).\n11. **Matrix contract** (contoh §5.3): sheet `(100,50)-(400,250)`, objek\n    `(150,60)-(250,120)`, placement `(0,0)` → `m = [1,0,0,1,260,130]`; apply ke\n    kedua sudut → `(410,190)` dan `(510,250)`; `bbox` world = `410,190,100,60`.\n12. **Rotasi 90 di world**: placement dengan `angle = 90` → bbox hasil tertukar\n    (w/h swap) dan hasil tetap di dalam sheet (cek semua vertex).\n13. **Unplaced layout**: 2 unplaced → `m` menempatkan bbox di kanan blok dengan\n    jarak tepat `gap` (10 mm), sumbu X sama, Y menurun, dan tidak beririsan\n    dengan bbox blok.\n14. **Gap**: dua part `grown` → jarak minimum antara `outer` asli ≥\n    `gap - 0.05 mm` (sampling edge-to-edge).\n15. **Progress**: semua yield `progress` monoton naik 0→1, `evals` berakhir =\n    `pop*gens + 1`, dan tidak ada yield setelah `done`.\n16. **Abort**: generator dibuang di tengah (`.return()`) → tidak ada exception,\n    tidak ada state global yang tertinggal (jalankan `run` lagi setelahnya).\n\nProbe mencetak juga benchmark: 20 kotak 100×60 di sheet 520×400, Normal,\n`ms`, `tests`, `collisions`, `fitness` — angka untuk dibandingkan antar\nperubahan, bukan assertion.\n\n### 12.2 Resep verifikasi browser (untuk owner)\n\nPersiapan: buka app seperti biasa, layer 1, zoom cukup untuk melihat ± 700×400 mm.\n\n1. **Gambar sheet**: Rectangle tool, warna **Mark (green) `#00ff00`**,\n   `300 × 200 mm` di sekitar `x 100..400, y 50..250`. Tidak perlu tertutup rapat\n   sempurna — loop dari 4 line sudah cukup, tapi jangan ada celah.\n2. **Gambar objek**:\n   - 3 kotak `100 × 60` hitam, tersebar.\n   - 1 ring: 2 circle `Ø80` dan `Ø40` sepusat (inner di dalam outer).\n   - 1 L-bracket: 6 line hitam membentuk L (mis. 120×120 dengan potongan 60×60).\n3. Pilih 3 kotak + ring + L (Ctrl+klik tiap loop; untuk ring **jangan** pilih\n   inner-nya terpisah — cukup Ctrl+klik di badannya, `Add` akan mendeteksi\n   lubang), lalu panel **Add selection**.\n   Yang harus terbaca: `Objects (5)`, ring tampil `2 loops, 1 hole`, L-bracket\n   `1 loop, 6 pts`.\n4. Amati:\n   - progress naik (tidak langsung 100), teks `eval n/31`, `Placed k/5`;\n   - saat progress ~50%, coba pan kanvas → harus tetap merespons;\n   - selesai < 10 s untuk 5 objek (target < 5 s).\n7. **Hasil yang diharapkan**:\n   - blok hasil muncul **10 mm di kanan** sheet (tepi kiri blok = `410 mm`\n     kalau sheet berakhir di `400`), rata atas dengan `y = 250`;\n   - 5 clone, tidak ada yang menimpa sheet atau master;\n   - status: `Placed 5/5 · block W×H mm · nn% · 31 evals · n.n s`, dengan\n     `W ≤ 300`, `H ≤ 200` (harus muat di sheet);\n   - master asli **tidak bergerak** (bandingkan L/T/W/H di panel transform\n     sebelum dan sesudah Nest — harus sama persis).\n8. **Clone mengikuti master**: klik satu master kotak, geser 30 mm ke bawah →\n   semua salinan hasil nesting harus **tetap di tempat** (tidak ikut bergeser).\n   Lalu ubah lebarnya (drag satu titik) → salinan ikut berubah bentuk.\n9. **Undo**: Ctrl+Z sekali → seluruh blok hasil hilang, master & sheet utuh.\n   Ctrl+Shift+Z → blok kembali di tempat yang sama.\n10. **Re-nest**: tekan Nest lagi → blok lama **diganti**, bukan menumpuk\n    (jumlah clone tetap 5). quality preset; `draw ms` dipantau owner |\n| Main thread (tanpa worker) | pan/zoom tersendat saat job | slice 12 ms + tidak ada alokasi per test; job bisa di-Stop |\n| Compound grouping salah (dua kotak bersarang yang bukan part+lubang) | objek dianggap berlubang | panel menampilkan `n loops, m holes` **sebelum** Nest; owner bisa Clear dan pilih ulang |\n| Loop berbagi entity dengan loop lain | clone ganda / grouping aneh | dideteksi saat Add (`entityIds` overlap) → toast \"loop berbagi entity, dilewati\" |\n| Simplify 0.02 mm memakan clearance saat `gap` kecil | part bersinggungan | clearance = gap − 0.04 mm; peringatan saat `gap < 0.5` |\n| Sheet hijau ganda (mis. guide hijau) | sheet salah | auto hanya kalau tepat satu; kalau lebih → wajib Pick |\n| Hasil menimpa master yang digambar di kanan sheet | tumpang tindih visual | `outX = max(sheet.maxX, masters.maxX) + 10` |\n| Clone dianggap \"hasil\" lalu diedit manual | re-nest menimpa editan | didokumentasikan di Help: edit master, bukan clone |\n| Undo besar (200 clone) | jeda sesaat | satu commit, satu `geometryEpoch` bump |\n\n### 13.2 Edge case & perilaku\n\n| Kasus | Perilaku |\n| --- | --- |\n| Tidak ada loop hijau | Nest disabled, hint |\n| >1 loop hijau & tidak ada yang dipilih | minta Pick |\n| Objek > sheet (semua varian) | semua unplaced; kalau 0 placement, tidak ada yang dipindah, status jelas |\n| 1 objek saja | decode 1 part, langsung ditempatkan di (0,0) varian terbaik |\n| Sheet berlubang | lubang jadi obstacle, part tidak ditaruh di sana |\n| Loop 2 titik (line bolak-balik) | area ~0 → dilewati dengan toast |\n| `gap` 0 | boleh, tapi peringatan clearance |\n| `rotation` kosong/invalid | fallback `[0]` |\n| Master dihapus saat job jalan | objek dilewati saat finish + toast |\n| Sheet dihapus saat job jalan | frame sudah snapshot; hasil tetap dibuat, status memperingatkan |\n| Objek di layer terkunci | tidak bisa terseleksi, jadi tidak masuk |\n| Dokumen besar (>1200 entity, render bulk) | tetap jalan; clone menambah sedikit entity |\n| Zoom ekstrem saat finish | clone dibuat di world coords, tidak terpengaruh zoom |\n| Undo saat job jalan | job membaca snapshot;
