- path: tools/nest.js
  content: |
      // MiniSketch nesting engine — trimmed port of KaryaCNC nestjs2/frontend
      // (js/geometry.js + js/nfp2.js + js/nfp_ga.js, GA + NFP2 only).
      // Classic script, no DOM, no imports. ClipperLib (tools/clipper.js) is required
      // at runtime by Path.offset(). Exposed as window.MiniSketchNest in the browser
      // and module.exports under Node so testing/nest_probe.js can load it.
      //
      // Conventions kept exactly as the reference:
      //   - all engine coordinates are integer mm * GEOM_SCALE (GEOM_SCALE = 1000)
      //   - a path with lcolor '#00ff00' is the SHEET: it is skipped from placement,
      //     its bounds define the sheet size and it appears in the placements as the
      //     sheet frame marker
      //   - spacing: every part is offset outward by spacing/2 before variants are
      //     built, so packing uses the grown shape and the visual gap equals spacing
      'use strict';
      
      // Timing summary is accumulated on the instance (NFPGA._lastPlaceMs /
      // _lastPlaceCount) and logged ONCE per run by the app ([nest] timing) —
      // no per-place log spam.
      const GEOM_SCALE = 1000;
      
      class Point {
        constructor(x, y) {
          this.x = x;
          this.y = y;
        }
        clone() {
          return new Point(this.x, this.y);
        }
      }
      
      // Matrix helper used by Path.translate/rotate/flip to track the accumulated
      // transform (kept for parity with the reference; MiniSketch does not export it).
      function multiplyMatrices(m1, m2) {
        const [a1, b1, c1, d1, e1, f1] = m1;
        const [a2, b2, c2, d2, e2, f2] = m2;
        return [
          a1 * a2 + b1 * c2,
          a1 * b2 + b1 * d2,
          c1 * a2 + d1 * c2,
          c1 * b2 + d1 * d2,
          e1 * a2 + f1 * c2 + e2,
          e1 * b2 + f1 * d2 + f2
        ];
      }
      
      class Path {
        constructor(paths = [], index, color = null, lcolor = null) {
          this.paths = paths;
          this.originIndex = index;
          this.lcolor = lcolor;
          if (lcolor === '#00ff00') color = '#ffffff';
          if (color == null || color === false) color = '#' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 16777215).toString(16);
          this.color = color;
          this._cachedBounds = null;
          this.transformMatrix = [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0];
          this.childIndex = [];
        }
      
        getBounds() {
          if (this._cachedBounds) return this._cachedBounds;
          const path0 = this.paths[0];
          if (!path0 || !path0.length) {
            this._cachedBounds = { x: 0, y: 0, pX: 0, pY: 0, width: 0, height: 0, fX: 0, fY: 0, fWidth: 0, fHeight: 0 };
            return this._cachedBounds;
          }
          let x = path0[0].x;
          let minX = x, maxX = x;
          let y = path0[0].y;
          let minY = y, maxY = y;
          let pMinX = x, pMinY = y;
          const len = path0.length;
          for (let i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            const point = path0[i];
            x = point.x;
            y = point.y;
            if (x < minX) minX = x;
            else if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
            if (y < minY) minY = y;
            else if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
            if (y < pMinY || (y === pMinY && x < pMinX)) {
              pMinX = x;
              pMinY = y;
            }
          }
          this._cachedBounds = {
            x: minX,
            y: minY,
            pX: pMinX,
            pY: pMinY,
            width: maxX - minX,
            height: maxY - minY,
            fX: minX / GEOM_SCALE,
            fY: minY / GEOM_SCALE,
            fWidth: (maxX - minX) / GEOM_SCALE,
            fHeight: (maxY - minY) / GEOM_SCALE
          };
          return this._cachedBounds;
        }
      
        invalidateBounds() {
          this._cachedBounds = null;
        }
      
        translate(dx, dy) {
          const matrix = [1, 0, 0, 1, dx, dy];
          this.transformMatrix = multiplyMatrices(this.transformMatrix, matrix);
          for (const path of this.paths) {
            path.forEach(point => {
              point.x += dx;
              point.y += dy;
            });
          }
          if (this._cachedBounds) {
            this._cachedBounds.x += dx;
            this._cachedBounds.y += dy;
          } else this.invalidateBounds();
          return this;
        }
      
        rotate(angle) {
          const rangle = angle * Math.PI / 180;
          const cos = Math.cos(rangle);
          const sin = Math.sin(rangle);
          this.invalidateBounds();
          const matrix = [cos, sin, -sin, cos, 0, 0];
          this.transformMatrix = multiplyMatrices(this.transformMatrix, matrix);
          this.paths.forEach(path => {

> _Reasoning_
> The code looks reasonable. It's a near-verbatim port with app-level parameters. The user complains it's slow and poor quality vs nestjs2.
> 
> Key suspects for "lambat":
> 1. `gridSize = gridMm * GEOM_SCALE` — reference default grid 4 mm → 4000 units. In the reference, `gridSize` is used as scanline step and candidate snapping. That's parity.
> 2. But `persist` / variants: `flip` default? Each variant triggers full `findBestNFPPlacement`.
> 3. The big one: **`Path.clone()` deep-copies all points for every variant, plus `offset`** — reference does too.
> 4. Another big one: the app calls engine with **world mm * 1000**, so coordinates are ~100000 units; the reference also used GEOM_SCALE=1000 with sheet 1000x1000mm → 1e6 units. Parity.
> 
> So where's the slowness? Perhaps the engine's `run` isn't used; the app drives a generator. Let's look at the app's generation loop and the NFPGA generator (line 1195-1330 in nest.js). Maybe the generator yields per placement which is fine.
>

      /**
       * True NFP (No-Fit Polygon) Algorithm Implementation
       * This provides proper geometric placement using NFP boundary sampling
       * instead of brute force collision detection
       */
      
      class NFP2SpatialHash {
          constructor(cellSize) {
              this.cellSize = cellSize;
              this.grid = new Map();
              this.queryId = 0;
              this.resultArray = [];
          }
      
          add(part) {
              const bounds = part.getBounds();
              const startX = Math.floor(bounds.x / this.cellSize);
              const endX = Math.floor((bounds.x + bounds.width) / this.cellSize);
              const startY = Math.floor(bounds.y / this.cellSize);
              const endY = Math.floor((bounds.y + bounds.height) / this.cellSize);
      
              for (let x = startX; x <= endX; x++) {
                  for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y++) {
                      const key = (x << 16) | (y & 0xFFFF);
                      if (!this.grid.has(key)) {
                          this.grid.set(key, []);
                      }
                      this.grid.get(key).push(part);
                  }
              }
          }
      
          remove(part) {
              const bounds = part.getBounds();
              const startX = Math.floor(bounds.x / this.cellSize);
              const endX = Math.floor((bounds.x + bounds.width) / this.cellSize);
              const startY = Math.floor(bounds.y / this.cellSize);
              const endY = Math.floor((bounds.y + bounds.height) / this.cellSize);
      
              for (let x = startX; x <= endX; x++) {
                  for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y++) {
                      const key = (x << 16) | (y & 0xFFFF);
                      const cell = this.grid.get(key);
                      if (cell) {
                          const idx = cell.indexOf(part);
                          if (idx !== -1) cell.splice(idx, 1);
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
      
          // Returns a REUSABLE array (deduped via queryId stamping) — the caller must
          // consume it before the next query. Parts may span several cells, so a part
          // appears in multiple cells; the stamping avoids pushing it more than once.
          query(bx, by, bw, bh) {
              const startX = Math.floor(bx / this.cellSize);
              const endX = Math.floor((bx + bw) / this.cellSize);
              const startY = Math.floor(by / this.cellSize);
              const endY = Math.floor((by + bh) / this.cellSize);
      
              const results = this.resultArray;
              results.length = 0;
              const qId = ++this.queryId;
      
              for (let x = startX; x <= endX; x++) {
                  for (let y = startY; y <= endY; y++) {
                      const key = (x << 16) | (y & 0xFFFF);
                      const cell = this.grid.get(key);
                      if (cell) {
                          const cellLen = cell.length;
                          for (let i = 0; i < cellLen; i++) {
                              const part = cell[i];
                              if (part._lastQueryId !== qId) {
                                  part._lastQueryId = qId;
                                  results.push(part);
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
              return results;
          }
      }
      
      class NFP2 {
          constructor() {
              this.spacing = 0;
              this.allowFlip = true;
              this.performanceStats = {
                  boundaryPointsTested: 0,
                  collisionAvoided: 0,
                  collisionChecks: 0
              };
              this.spatialHash = null;
              this.gridSize = 10;
              // Last full-nest placements, reused as fixed obstacles during renest().
              this.lastPlacements = [];
          }
      
          setSpacing(spacing) {
              this.spacing = spacing * GEOM_SCALE;
              this.gridSize = spacing > 0 ? spacing * GEOM_SCALE : GEOM_SCALE;
          }
          setAllowFlip(allowFlip) { this.allowFlip = allowFlip; }
      
          findBestPosition(parts, sheet, progressHandler, gridSize, initialPlacements = []) {
              const startTime = performance.now();
              // gridSize is already scaled
              const scaledGridSize = gridSize;
              const scaledSheet = {
                  width: sheet.width * GEOM_SCALE,
                  height: sheet.height * GEOM_SCALE
              };
              this.performanceStats = {
                  boundaryPointsTested: 0,
                  collisionAvoided: 0,
                  collisionChecks: 0
              };
      
              // Set of originIndexes already fixed as initial placements (renesting).
              // These must NOT be re-placed, otherwise they would appear twice.
              this._initialIndexSet = initialPlacements.length > 0
                  ? new Set(initialPlacements.map(p => p.originIndex))
                  : null;
      
              const cellSize = Math.max(50 * GEOM_SCALE, scaledGridSize * 5);
              this.spatialHash = new NFP2SpatialHash(cellSize);
      
              let bestPlacementsAll = [...initialPlacements];
              // Add initial placements to spatial hash
              initialPlacements.forEach(p => this.spatialHash.add(p));
      
              const totalParts = parts.length;
              this.hascustomsheet = false;
      
              // Full nest (Start nesting) clears all placement flags.
              parts.forEach(p => { p.placed = false; });
      
              // Run the shared placement loop (also used by renest()).
              this._runPlacementPasses(parts, bestPlacementsAll, scaledSheet, scaledGridSize, progressHandler, totalParts);
      
              const endTime = performance.now();
              console.log(`NFP2 Performance:`, {
                  time: `${(endTime - startTime).toFixed(2)}ms`,
                  partsProcessed: totalParts,
                  ...this.performanceStats
              });
      
              this.lastPlacements = bestPlacementsAll;
              return bestPlacementsAll;
          }
      
          /**
           * Shared core placement loop. Places every part in `parts` whose `placed`
           * flag is false, using the already-placed parts and the seeded spatial hash
           * as fixed obstacles. Used by both findBestPosition (full nest) and
           * renest() (partial re-placement of marked parts).
           *
           * NOTE: this method intentionally does NOT reset part.placed flags. The
           * caller decides which parts should be re-placed (placed=false).
           */
          _runPlacementPasses(parts, bestPlacementsAll, scaledSheet, scaledGridSize, progressHandler, totalParts) {
              const partData = new Map();
              let maxArea = 0, minArea = Infinity;
      
              for (const part of parts) {
                  // Fixed (already placed) parts act as obstacles; skip them here.
                  if (part.placed) continue;
                  // Parts fixed as initial placements should not be re-placed.
                  if (this._initialIndexSet && this._initialIndexSet.has(part.originIndex)) {
                      part.placed = true;
                      continue;
                  }
                  if (part.lcolor === "#00ff00") {
                      const sheetVariant = part.variants[0];
                      sheetVariant.align();
                      const bounds = sheetVariant.getBounds();
                      scaledSheet.width = bounds.width;
                      scaledSheet.height = bounds.height;
                      this.hascustomsheet = true;
                      const placedSheet = sheetVariant.clone();
                      bestPlacementsAll.push(placedSheet);
                      this.spatialHash.add(placedSheet);
                      part.placed = true;
                      continue;
                  }
                  const b = part.variants[0].getBounds();
                  const longestSide = Math.max(b.width, b.height);
                  const area = longestSide * longestSide;
                  partData.set(part, { area, aspectRatio: b.width / b.height });
                  maxArea = Math.max(maxArea, area);
                  minArea = Math.min(minArea, area);
              }
      
              const remainingParts = parts.filter(part => !part.placed && part.lcolor !== "#00ff00");
              const areaRange = maxArea - minArea;
              const thresholds = [
                  minArea + areaRange * 0.75,
                  minArea + areaRange * 0.5,
                  minArea + areaRange * 0.25,
                  minArea
              ];
      
              // Process in 4 passes like nfp.js to ensure large parts are prioritized.
              for (let pass = 0; pass < 4; pass++) {
                  const passParts = remainingParts.filter(part => {
                      if (part.placed) return false;
                      const area = partData.get(part).area;
                      if (pass === 0) return area >= thresholds[0];
                      if (pass === 1) return area >= thresholds[1];
                      if (pass === 2) return area >= thresholds[2];
                      return true;
                  });
      
                  passParts.sort((a, b) => {
                      const aD = partData.get(a);
                      const bD = partData.get(b);
                      const scoreA = aD.area * Math.abs(1 - aD.aspectRatio);
                      const scoreB = bD.area * Math.abs(1 - bD.aspectRatio);
                      const noise = (Math.random() - 0.5) * (scoreA + scoreB) * 0.1;
                      return scoreB - scoreA + noise;
                  });
      
                  for (let part of passParts) {
                      if (part.placed) continue;
                      const bestPlacement = this.findBestNFPPlacement(part, bestPlacementsAll, scaledSheet, scaledGridSize);
                      if (bestPlacement) {
                          bestPlacement.childIndex = part.childIndex;
                          bestPlacementsAll.push(bestPlacement);
                          this.spatialHash.add(bestPlacement);
                          part.placed = true;
                      }
                      if (progressHandler) progressHandler(bestPlacementsAll.length, totalParts);
                  }
              }
          }
      
          /**
           * Partial re-nesting: re-place only the parts whose `placed` flag is false,
           * using the last full-nest result (this.lastPlacements) as fixed obstacles.
           * Does NOT reset part positions — the caller marks exactly the parts to move.
           */
          renest(parts, sheet, progressHandler, gridSize) {
              const startTime = performance.now();
              const scaledGridSize = gridSize;
              const scaledSheet = {
                  width: sheet.width * GEOM_SCALE,
                  height: sheet.height * GEOM_SCALE
              };
              const totalParts = parts.length;
      
              const markedSet = new Set();
              for (const p of parts) {
                  if (p.placed === false) markedSet.add(p.originIndex);
              }
      
              const fixedPlacements = (this.lastPlacements || []).filter(p => !markedSet.has(p.originIndex));
      
              this.performanceStats = { boundaryPointsTested: 0, collisionAvoided: 0, collisionChecks: 0 };
              this._initialIndexSet = new Set(fixedPlacements.map(p => p.originIndex));
      
              const cellSize = Math.max(50 * GEOM_SCALE, scaledGridSize * 5);
              this.spatialHash = new NFP2SpatialHash(cellSize);
              fixedPlacements.forEach(p => this.spatialHash.add(p));
      
              for (const p of fixedPlacements) {
                  if (p.lcolor === "#00ff00") {
                      const b = p.getBounds();
                      scaledSheet.width = b.width;
                      scaledSheet.height = b.height;
                      this.hascustomsheet = true;
                      break;
                  }
              }
      
              const bestPlacementsAll = fixedPlacements.slice();
              this._runPlacementPasses(parts, bestPlacementsAll, scaledSheet, scaledGridSize, progressHandler, totalParts);
      
              const endTime = performance.now();
              console.log(`NFP2 Renest Performance:`, {
                  time: `${(endTime - startTime).toFixed(2)}ms`,
                  partsProcessed: totalParts,
                  rePlaced: markedSet.size,
                  ...this.performanceStats
              });
      
              this.lastPlacements = bestPlacementsAll;
              return bestPlacementsAll;
          }
      
          findBestNFPPlacement(part, placedPartsAll, sheet, gridSize) {
              const sheetParts = placedPartsAll.filter(p => p.lcolor === "#00ff00");
              let bestPlacement = null;
              let bestScore = Infinity;
      
              // 1. Scanline-based search (The Speed/Compactness from nfp.js)
              // gridSize is already scaled
              const yStep = Math.max(4 * GEOM_SCALE, gridSize);
              const xStep = Math.max(4 * GEOM_SCALE, gridSize);
      
              // Precompute each placed part's vertical span once, so the scanline
              // loop can skip parts that cannot cross the current y without calling
              // getBounds() (or getHorizontalIntersections) for every scanline.
              const scanParts = placedPartsAll.map(p => {
                  const b = p.getBounds();
                  return { p, minY: b.y, maxY: b.y + b.height };
              });
      
              for (let y = 0; y < sheet.height; y += yStep) {
                  const intersections = [];
                  let sheetRange = [0, sheet.width];
      
                  for (const sp of scanParts) {
                      if (y < sp.minY || y > sp.maxY) continue;
                      const placed = sp.p;
                      const pts = GeometryUtil.getHorizontalIntersections(placed, y);
                      if (placed.lcolor === "#00ff00") {
                          if (pts.length >= 2) {
                              pts.sort((a, b) => a - b);
                              sheetRange = [pts[0], pts[pts.length - 1]];
                          }
                      } else {
                          intersections.push(...pts);
                      }
                  }
                  intersections.sort((a, b) => a - b);
      
                  for (let x = sheetRange[0]; x <= sheetRange[1]; x += xStep) {
                      let insideAnyPart = false;
                      for (let i = 0; i < intersections.length; i += 2) {
                          if (x >= intersections[i] && x <= intersections[i + 1]) {
                              x = Math.ceil(intersections[i + 1]);
                              insideAnyPart = true;
                              break;
                          }
                      }
                      if (insideAnyPart) continue;
      
                      for (let variant of part.variants) {
                          const b = variant.getBounds();
                          const dx = x - b.x;
                          const dy = y - b.y;
      
                          if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x + b.width > sheet.width || y + b.height > sheet.height) continue;
      
                          const score = (y + b.height * 2) * 2 + (x * 0.1) + (variant.paths.length > 1 ? 1000 * GEOM_SCALE : 0);
                          if (score > bestScore + 100) continue;
      
                          variant.insideBonus = 0;
                          if (!this.checkCollisions(variant, dx, dy, sheetParts)) {
                              const finalScore = score - (variant.insideBonus || 0);
                              if (finalScore < bestScore) {
                                  bestScore = finalScore;
                                  bestPlacement = variant.clone(dx, dy);
                                  if (variant.insideBonus > 5000) return bestPlacement;
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  }
                  // Stop evaluation if we have a very solid result at the top
                  if (bestPlacement && y > sheet.height / 3) break;
              }
      
              // 2. Vertex Refinement (The Precision from NFP)
              // If we haven't found a perfect top spot, try one fast pass through NFP vertices
              if (!bestPlacement || bestScore > (sheet.height * 0.5)) {
                  const edgeCandidates = this.getCandidatePositions(part.variants[0], placedPartsAll, sheet, gridSize);
                  for (let pos of edgeCandidates) {
                      const b = part.variants[0].getBounds();
                      const score = ((pos.y + b.y) + b.height * 2) * 2 + ((pos.x + b.x) * 0.1);
                      if (score < bestScore) {
                          if (!this.checkCollisions(part.variants[0], pos.x, pos.y, sheetParts)) {
                              bestPlacement = part.variants[0].clone(pos.x, pos.y);
                              bestScore = score;
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return bestPlacement;
          }
      
          getCandidatePositions(part, placedParts, sheet, gridSize) {
              const positions = [];
              const pb = part.getBounds();
              const pW = pb.width;
              const pH = pb.height;
      
              // 1. Initial start points along the top and left to encourage top-left packing
              const startStep = gridSize * 2;
              for (let x = 0; x <= sheet.width; x += startStep) {
                  positions.push({ x: x - pb.x, y: -pb.y });
              }
              for (let y = 0; y <= sheet.height / 2; y += startStep) {
                  positions.push({ x: -pb.x, y: y - pb.y });
              }
      
              if (placedParts.length === 0) return positions;
      
              const seen = new Set();
              const addPos = (x, y) => {
                  const k = `${Math.round(x)},${Math.round(y)}`;
                  if (!seen.has(k)) {
                      positions.push({ x, y });
                      seen.add(k);
                  }
              };
      
              // Pre-sample vertices from the new part to try vertex-to-vertex alignment
              const newPartPath = part.paths[0];
              const vSamples = [];
      
              // Use corners + center-edge points. Add more for "Maximum Packing" mode.
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x, y: pb.y });
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW, y: pb.y });
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW, y: pb.y + pH });
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x, y: pb.y + pH });
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW / 2, y: pb.y });
              vSamples.push({ x: pb.x, y: pb.y + pH / 2 });
      
              if (this.gridSize < 3) {
                  // Maximum Packing: add more mid-points
                  vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW / 2, y: pb.y + pH });
                  vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW, y: pb.y + pH / 2 });
                  vSamples.push({ x: pb.x + pW / 2, y: pb.y + pH / 2 });
              }
      
              for (const placed of placedParts) {
                  if (placed.lcolor === "#00ff00") continue; // Sheets handled by scanline
      
                  for (const path of placed.paths) {
                      const len = path.length;
                      if (len < 2) continue;
      
                      // Dynamic vertex sampling based on gridSize (Smaller = More Precise)
                      const vSkip = Math.max(1, Math.floor(gridSize / (2 * GEOM_SCALE)));
                      for (let i = 0; i < len; i += vSkip) {
                          const pt = path[i];
                          for (const v of vSamples) {
                              addPos(pt.x - v.x, pt.y - v.y);
                          }
                      }
                  }
              }
      
              return positions.filter(p => {
                  const bx = p.x + pb.x;
                  const by = p.y + pb.y;
                  return bx >= 0 && bx + pb.width <= sheet.width &&
                      by >= 0 && by + pb.height <= sheet.height;
              });
          }
      
          checkCollisions(variant, dx, dy, sheetParts) {
              const vBounds = variant.getBounds();
              const bx = vBounds.x + dx;
              const by = vBounds.y + dy;
              const bw = vBounds.width;
              const bh = vBounds.height;
      
              // 1. Sheet constraints
              for (const s of sheetParts) {
                  this.performanceStats.collisionChecks++;
                  if (GeometryUtil.polyOutsideAt(variant, dx, dy, s)) return true;
              }
      
              const candidates = this.spatialHash.query(bx, by, bw, bh);
      
              // Note: initial/fixed placements are always seeded into the spatial
              // hash, and overlapping bboxes provably share a grid cell, so the
              // hash query already returns every relevant placed part.
      
              // 2. Part intersections
              for (const placed of candidates) {
                  if (placed.lcolor === "#00ff00") continue;
      
                  const pb = placed._cachedBounds || placed.getBounds();
                  if (bx > pb.x + pb.width || bx + bw < pb.x ||
                      by > pb.y + pb.height || by + bh < pb.y) {
                      continue;
                  }
      
                  this.performanceStats.collisionChecks++;
                  if (GeometryUtil.polygonsIntersectAt(variant, dx, dy, placed, true)) return true;
              }
      
              return false;
          }
      
          calculateTotalBounds(parts) {
              if (parts.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, width: 10, height: 10 };
              let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
              for (const part of parts) {
                  if (part.lcolor === "#00ff00") continue;
                  const b = part.getBounds();
                  minX = Math.min(minX, b.x);
                  minY = Math.min(minY, b.y);
                  maxX = Math.max(maxX, b.x + b.width);
                  maxY = Math.max(maxY, b.y + b.height);
              }
              return { x: minX, y: minY, width: maxX - minX, height: maxY - minY };
          }
      
          getPerformanceStats() { return this.performanceStats; }
      
          compactSolution(placements, sheet) {
              const cellSize = (this.spatialHash && this.spatialHash.cellSize) ||
                  Math.max(50 * GEOM_SCALE, (this.gridSize || 10) * 5);
              this.spatialHash = new NFP2SpatialHash(cellSize);
              placements.forEach(p => this.spatialHash.add(p));
              const sheetParts = placements.filter(p => p.lcolor === "#00ff00");
      
              const collisionCheck = (part, phase) => {
                  if (part.lcolor === "#00ff00") return false;
      
                  if (phase === 'start') {
                      this.spatialHash.remove(part);
                      return false;
                  }
                  if (phase === 'end') {
                      this.spatialHash.add(part);
                      return false;
                  }
      
                  const b = part.getBounds();
                  if (b.x < 0 || b.y < 0 || b.x + b.width > sheet.width * GEOM_SCALE || b.y + b.height > sheet.height * GEOM_SCALE) {
                      return true;
                  }
      
                  return this.checkCollisions(part, 0, 0, sheetParts);
              };
      
              const moves = GeometryUtil.compactLayout(placements, collisionCheck);
              console.log(`NFP2 Compaction done. Multi-pass moves: ${moves}`);
              return placements;
          }
      
          checkDragPlacement(part, x, y, placedParts, sheet) {

                  width: sheet.width * GEOM_SCALE,
                  height: sheet.height * GEOM_SCALE

              const bounds = part.getBounds();
              const bx = bounds.x;
              const by = bounds.y;
              const bw = bounds.width;
              const bh = bounds.height;
      
              // Check sheet boundaries with small epsilon
              const EPS = 0.01 * GEOM_SCALE;
              if (bx < -EPS || by < -EPS || bx + bw > scaledSheet.width + EPS || by + bh > scaledSheet.height + EPS) {

      /**
       * GA + NFP2 placement optimizer.
       *
       * Genetic Algorithm whose chromosome is ONLY the placement order
       * (a permutation of part indexes). The decoder is the existing,
       * unmodified NFP2.findBestNFPPlacement, called once per part in
       * chromosome order. Geometry, collision, offset, holes, export and
       * the worker protocol are untouched — this file only decides
       * "which part goes next".
       *
       * Fitness  = bounding-box area + total bbox area part yang tidak ternesting
       * (sisa besar = rugi bahan baru, sisa kecil masih bisa pakai bahan sisa).
       * Elitism always keeps the descending-size baseline individual, so a
       * GA run can never score worse than the plain heuristic order.
       */
      class NFPGA {
          constructor() {
              this.spacing = 0;
              this.allowFlip = true;
              this.gridSize = 10;
              this.performanceStats = {
                  generations: 0,
                  evaluations: 0,
                  collisionChecks: 0,
                  bestFitness: Infinity
              };
              // Last full-nest placements, reused as fixed obstacles during renest().
              this.lastPlacements = [];
              this.hascustomsheet = false;
              // GA hyper-parameters (defaults agreed with user).
              this.popSize = 6;
              this.generations = 5;
              this.mutationRate = 0.1;
          }
      
          setSpacing(spacing) {
              this.spacing = spacing * GEOM_SCALE;
              this.gridSize = spacing > 0 ? spacing * GEOM_SCALE : GEOM_SCALE;
          }
      
          setAllowFlip(allowFlip) { this.allowFlip = allowFlip; }
      
          setGAParams(popSize, generations, mutationRate) {
              if (popSize > 1) this.popSize = Math.floor(popSize);
              if (generations > 0) this.generations = Math.floor(generations);
              if (mutationRate >= 0 && mutationRate <= 1) this.mutationRate = mutationRate;
          }
      
          // ---- pure permutation helpers (no geometry here) ----
      
          _shuffled(n) {
              const a = [];
              for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) a.push(i);
              for (let i = n - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                  const j = (Math.random() * (i + 1)) | 0;
                  const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
              }
              return a;
          }
      
          // Order crossover (OX): copy a slice of p1, fill the rest in p2 order.
          _crossover(p1, p2) {
              const n = p1.length;
              if (n < 2) return p1.slice();
              let a = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
              let b = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
              if (a > b) { const t = a; a = b; b = t; }
              const child = new Array(n).fill(-1);
              const used = new Set();
              for (let i = a; i <= b; i++) { child[i] = p1[i]; used.add(p1[i]); }
              let j = (b + 1) % n;
              for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                  const g = p2[(b + 1 + i) % n];
                  if (!used.has(g)) { child[j] = g; used.add(g); j = (j + 1) % n; }
              }
              return child;
          }
      
          // One random mutation of the placement order: swap two positions,
          // relocate one part, or invert a random segment.
          _mutateOrder(order) {
              const n = order.length;
              if (n < 2) return order;
              const a = order.slice();
              const r = Math.random();
              if (r < 0.5) {
                  const i = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
                  let j = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
                  if (i === j) j = (j + 1) % n;
                  const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t;
              } else if (r < 0.8) {
                  const i = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
                  const g = a.splice(i, 1)[0];
                  a.splice((Math.random() * (n - 1 + 1)) | 0, 0, g);
              } else {
                  let i = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
                  let j = (Math.random() * n) | 0;
                  if (i > j) { const t = i; i = j; j = t; }
                  while (i < j) { const t = a[i]; a[i] = a[j]; a[j] = t; i++; j--; }
              }
              return a;
          }
      
          // Random rotation-gene vector: one variant index per entry position.
          _randomRots() {
              return this._variantCounts.map(c => (Math.random() * c) | 0);

          // Uniform crossover of two rotation vectors.
          _crossoverRots(r1, r2) {

          _mutate(ind) {

                  const c = this._variantCounts[i];
                  if (c > 1) {
                      let v = (Math.random() * c) | 0;

              if (seed.order.length !== n || seed.rots.length !== n) return false;

              for (const v of seed.order) {

                  if (fits[c] < fits[best]) best = c;

              let a = 0;
              if (e.variants && e.variants.length > 0) {

                  a = b.width * b.height;
              }
              e._gaArea = a;
              return a;
          }

           * Jadi GA memprioritaskan part BESAR lebih dulu: sisa besar = rugi bahan
           * baru, sisa kecil masih bisa pakai bahan sisa.

          _evaluate(ind, ctx) {

              const dec = new NFP2();
              dec.spacing = this.spacing;
              dec.allowFlip = this.allowFlip;
              dec.gridSize = this.gridSize;
              dec.performanceStats = { boundaryPointsTested: 0, collisionAvoided: 0, collisionChecks: 0 };
              const cellSize = Math.max(50 * GEOM_SCALE, ctx.gridSize * 5);
              dec.spatialHash = new NFP2SpatialHash(cellSize);
      
              const sheet = { width: ctx.scaledSheet.width, height: ctx.scaledSheet.height };
              const placed = ctx.fixed.slice();
              for (const p of placed) dec.spatialHash.add(p);
      
              // Custom sheet outlines (green) become the sheet, exactly like NFP2.
              for (const e of ctx.entries) {

                  sv.align();
                  const b = sv.getBounds();
                  sheet.width = b.width;
                  sheet.height = b.height;

                  .map((p, i) => ({ part: p, idx: i }))
                  .filter(e => !initialSet.has(e.part.originIndex));
              const placeables = entries.filter(e => e.part.lcolor !== '#00ff00');
      
              // Degenerate case: nothing to order, keep NFP2 behaviour.

                  dec.spacing = this.spacing;
                  dec.allowFlip = this.allowFlip;
                  dec.gridSize = gridSize;
                  const out = dec.findBestPosition(parts, sheet, progressHandler, gridSize, initialPlacements);
                  this.lastPlacements = dec.lastPlacements;
                  this.hascustomsheet = dec.hascustomsheet;

              const popSize = Math.max(2, this.popSize);

              while (pop.length < popSize) pop.push({ order: this._shuffled(n), rots: this._randomRots() });

              let evalsDone = 0;

                  const r = this._evaluate(o, ctx);

              const ELITES = Math.min(2, pop.length);
              for (let g = 0; g < this.generations; g++) {
                  const ranked = pop.map((o, i) => i).sort((a, b) => fits[a] - fits[b]);

              this.bestOrder = { order: bestInd.order.slice(), rots: bestInd.rots.slice() };
      
              const endTime = performance.now();

              if (parts.length === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0, width: 10, height: 10 };
              let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
              for (const part of parts) {
                  if (part.lcolor === '#00ff00') continue;
                  const b = part.getBounds();
                  minX = Math.min(minX, b.x);
                  minY = Math.min(minY, b.y);
                  maxX = Math.max(maxX, b.x + b.width);

// Handle messages from main thread
self.onmessage = function (e) {
    const { parts, sheet, gridSize, algorithm, initialPlacements, gaParams, seedOrder } = e.data;

    // Create NFP instance based on algorithm
    let nfp;
    if (algorithm === 'nfp2') {
        nfp = new NFP2();
    } else if (algorithm === 'optimized') {
        nfp = new NFPOptimized();
    } else if (algorithm === 'ga') {
        nfp = new NFPGA();
        if (gaParams) nfp.setGAParams(gaParams.popSize, gaParams.generations, gaParams.mutationRate);
    } else {
        nfp = new NFP();
    }
    nfp.gridSize = gridSize;

    // Rehydrate initial placements
    const rehydratedInitial = (initialPlacements || []).map(plainPath => {
        const newPaths = plainPath.paths.map(p => p.map(pt => new Point(pt.x, pt.y)));
        const newPath = new Path(newPaths, plainPath.originIndex, plainPath.color, plainPath.lcolor);
        newPath.transformMatrix = plainPath.transformMatrix;
        newPath.childIndex = plainPath.childIndex;
        return newPath;
    });

    parts.forEach(part => {
        part.variants = part.variants.map(variant => {
            const variantPath = new Path(
                variant.paths,
                variant.originIndex,
                variant.color,
                variant.lcolor
            );
            variantPath.childIndex = variant.childIndex;
            variantPath.transformMatrix = variant.transformMatrix;
            return variantPath;
        })
    });

    // Add progress handler
    const progressHandler = (placedCount, totalParts) => {
        self.postMessage({
            type: 'progress',
            progress: (placedCount / totalParts) * 100
        });
    };

    const bestPlacements = (algorithm === 'ga')
        ? nfp.findBestPosition(parts, sheet, progressHandler, gridSize, rehydratedInitial, seedOrder || null)
        : nfp.findBestPosition(parts, sheet, progressHandler, gridSize, rehydratedInitial);

            color: part.color,
            lcolor: part.lcolor,
            originIndex: part.originIndex,
            childIndex: part.childIndex,
            transformMatrix: [...part.transformMatrix]
        };
        return result;
    });

    // Send back final results
    self.postMessage({
        type: 'result',
        placements: transferablePlacements,
        area: area / (GEOM_SCALE * GEOM_SCALE),
        stats: nfp.getPerformanceStats(),
        bestOrder: nfp.bestOrder || null
    });
};

        function nestCollectLoops() {
          const loops = getLoops();
          const guides = ownedGuideIds();
          const sheetLoops = [];
          const partLoops = [];
          for (const loop of loops) {
            if (!loopShapeSelected(loop)) continue;
            const eids = loopEntities(loop).filter(eid => !guides.has(+eid));
            if (!eids.length) continue;
            const allGreen = eids.every(eid => {
              const e = state.entities[eid];
              return e && isConstructionColor(colorOf(e));
            });
            (allGreen ? sheetLoops : partLoops).push({ loop, entityIds: eids });
          }
          return { sheetLoops, partLoops };
        }
      
        // Group part loops into objects: a loop fully inside another loop becomes
        // that loop's hole (compound part = one object). Uses the sampled loop
        // polygon and pointInPoly from core.js.
        function nestGroupParts(partLoops) {
          const items = partLoops.map(rec => ({ rec, area: rec.loop.area }));
          items.sort((a, b) => b.area - a.area); // outer candidates first
          const objects = [];
          for (const it of items) {
            let parent = null;
            for (const obj of objects) {
              const poly = obj.outer.loop.poly;
              if (poly && poly.length > 2 && pointInPoly(it.rec.loop.poly[0], poly)) { parent = obj; break; }
            }
            if (parent) parent.holeRecs.push(it.rec);
            else objects.push({ outer: it.rec, holeRecs: [] });
          }
          return objects;
        }

          const GEOM = MiniSketchNest.GEOM_SCALE;
          const angles = nestRotationAngles(rotation);
          // variant list: for each angle one base variant, plus a flipped twin when
          // flip is on (so rotList order is angle0, angle0-flip, angle1, ...)
          const rotList = [];
          for (const a of angles) {
            rotList.push({ a, f: false });
            if (flip) rotList.push({ a, f: true });
          }
          const entries = [];
          // parts: poly (mm -> engine units); offset() grows by distance/2 on every
          // side, so offset(spacingMm) reserves spacingMm/2 per part — the packing
          // gap between two ORIGINAL outlines ends up exactly spacingMm (reference
          // behaviour: packing uses the grown shape, the result draws the original).
          for (let oi = 0; oi < objects.length; oi++) {
            const obj = objects[oi];
            // Engine space == WORLD mm, Y-up, NO flip: what the engine packs is
            // what the clone draws (upright). The engine packs small-y first, so
            // the block grows from the sheet's y=0; nestApplyResult centers the
            // finished block inside the sheet frame vertically.
            // ClipperOffset only keeps a hole when its winding opposes the outer
            // path, so the hole poly is reversed when needed before building the
            // engine Path.
            const mkPath = (rec, holes) => {
              const paths = [rec.loop.poly.map(p => new MiniSketchNest.Point(p.x * GEOM, p.y * GEOM))];
              const outerArea = MiniSketchNest.Path.getSignedArea(paths[0]);
              for (const h of holes) {
                const hp = h.loop.poly.map(p => new MiniSketchNest.Point(p.x * GEOM, p.y * GEOM));
                if (Math.sign(MiniSketchNest.Path.getSignedArea(hp)) === Math.sign(outerArea)) hp.reverse();
                paths.push(hp);
              }
              return new MiniSketchNest.Path(paths, oi + 1, null, null);
            };
            const base = mkPath(obj.outer, obj.holeRecs);
            base.align();
            // Spacing is a pure PREPROCESSOR (exactly like nestjs2): offset the part
            // outward by spacing/2 per side once, before nesting. It never plays a
            // role during the search itself. Sp = 0 means no offset at all.
            const opart = base.clone().offset(spacingMm);
            const variants = [];
            for (const { a: rot, f: useFlip } of rotList) {
              const v = opart.clone();
              if (useFlip) v.flip();
              if (rot !== 0) v.rotate(rot);
              else v.align();
              variants.push(v);
            }
            entries.push({
              originIndex: oi + 1,
              lcolor: null,
              childIndex: [],
              variants,
              _rec: { outer: obj.outer, holes: obj.holeRecs, nPerAngle: flip ? 2 : 1 }
            });
          }
          // sheet: exactly one green loop, same space as the parts (world mm)
          if (sheetLoops.length === 1) {

          }

        //   "0,90,180"            comma-separated angles
        //   "0-360:90"            range with step ("0-90:15,180,270" mixes both)
        function nestRotationAngles(rotationString) {
          if (!rotationString) return [0];
          const rotation = String(rotationString);
          // old integer presets (only when the string is a bare number)
          const rotationInt = parseInt(rotation);
          if (!rotation.includes(',') && !rotation.includes('-') && !isNaN(rotationInt)) {
            switch (rotationInt) {
              case 1: return [0];
              case 2: return [0, 180];
              case 3: return [0, 90];
              case 4: return [0, 90, 180, 270];
              case 8: return [0, 45, 90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315];

          const items = rotation.split(',').map(s => s.trim());

> _Reasoning_
> `SPLINE_SEG` — probably 12 or user-configurable ("Curve segments per span"). With 12 per span and e.g. 20 control points → 240 points. For imported DXF/SVG art, splines can be many spans → thousands of points. That's likely.
> 
> But hold on — the owner said nestjs2 was the ground truth and its result was fast/good. Same shapes? Maybe the owner uses SVG import in nestjs2 but in MiniSketch draws shapes (lines/circles) — then points are few.
> 
> The port's engine is faster than the reference in my measurement. So "lambat" in the app must come from something else:
> - Scheduler: `setTimeout(step, 0)` slices of 12ms, and `nestPaintProgress` each slice — fine.
> - The yield granularity: yields after **every part placement**. Each part placement is ~ (total time)/(placements). With 14 parts and 27 evals → ~350 placements → 740ms/350 ≈ 2ms each. Fine.
> - BUT: `nestApplyResult` builds clone entities; then `updateUI()` maybe triggers `getLoops()` rebuild — could be slow but not "nesting slow".
> 
> Hmm, maybe the real issue: **flip default checked + rotation "0,90,180,270"** → 8 variants/part, and each variant is a full dense poly. GA `_placeWithVariant` uses one variant, fine.
> 
> Wait, there's something important in `nestBuildEntries`: `const base = mkPath(obj.outer, obj.holeRecs); base.align();` then `opart = base.clone().offset(spacingMm)`. **`Path.offset` with spacing 0 returns this** (because distance===0). Fine.
> 
> But `offset` uses Clipper with `distance * GEOM_SCALE / 2` where distance is in mm → correct: spacing/2.
> 
> Hmm what about `align()`? For non-sheet Path, align uses `-pX, -pY` (the lexicographically lowest-y point) — same as reference.
> 
> OK, so where's the app slow? Let me consider the possibility the owner's judgment of "slow" comes from comparing the reference at **spacing 0 with grid 1mm** to the port at grid 4mm? Then port would be much faster...
> 
> Alternatively the owner's complaint "quality jelek" might be real and about layout: e.g., parts land overlapping (bug in clone matrix), or ugly because the block is placed to the right and the frame clone is wrong. And "lambat" because **each re-run recomputes all variants including offset with Clipper** — minor.
> 
> I need data, not speculation. Per agents.md rule 4: instrument and ask. But we can also test the *actual app input* path in Node: the app's `nestBuildEntries` is inside app.js closure — can't call directly. But `testing/nest_app_probe.js` exists (448 lines) — maybe it replicates app logic. Let me read it; maybe it already has a fake state and calls nest functions. Also read `testing/nest_probe.js`.
> 
> Also: maybe the agent's implementation has a *known* bug they logged. Let me read FINAL plan file `Finalnestingplan.md`? Not needed.
> 
> Bigger idea: the app might call the engine with the sheet in **world coordinates far from origin**. `sheetPath.align()` translates to 0,0 — good. But the *parts* are built with world coords then aligned to their own bbox. Good.

> But `nestApplyResult`: `nestPlacementMatrixAt` for variants, and `inset`. Quality complaint could be "parts not snug" (gap wrong) etc.

// Node probe for tools/nest.js — no DOM, loads ClipperLib from tools/clipper.js
// the same way the browser does (vm sandbox), then exercises the GA + NFP2
// engine. Exit 1 on any failure.
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const vm = require('vm');

const ROOT = path.join(__dirname, '..');

function loadClassic(file, sandbox) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  vm.runInContext(src, sandbox, { filename: file });
}

const sandbox = {
  console,
  performance: { now: () => Date.now() },
  Math,
  setTimeout,
  navigator: { userAgent: 'node' },
  self: {},
  window: {},
  // clipper.js detects `typeof module && module.exports` INSIDE the vm context
  // and takes the CommonJS branch, so hand it a fake `module` and copy the
  // export back to the bare global the engine reads.
  module: { exports: {} },
};
sandbox.globalThis = sandbox;
vm.createContext(sandbox);

loadClassic(path.join(ROOT, 'tools/clipper.js'), sandbox);
sandbox.ClipperLib = sandbox.module.exports;
delete sandbox.module;
loadClassic(path.join(ROOT, 'tools/nest.js'), sandbox);

const Nest = sandbox.window.MiniSketchNest;
const { GEOM_SCALE, Point, Path, GeometryUtil, NFP2SpatialHash, NFP2, NFPGA } = Nest;

let fails = 0;
let count = 0;
function ok(cond, name) {
  count++;
  if (!cond) { fails++; console.log('FAIL: ' + name); }
  else console.log('ok: ' + name);
}
function close(a, b, eps, name) {
  ok(Math.abs(a - b) <= eps, name + ' (' + a + ' vs ' + b + ')');
}

// helper: build an engine Path from mm polygon(s)
function polyPath(outerMm, holesMm, originIndex, lcolor) {
  const paths = [outerMm.map(p => new Point(p[0] * GEOM_SCALE, p[1] * GEOM_SCALE))];
  for (const h of holesMm || []) {
    paths.push(h.map(p => new Point(p[0] * GEOM_SCALE, p[1] * GEOM_SCALE)));
  }
  return new Path(paths, originIndex, null, lcolor || null);
}

        function nestApplyResult(job, placements, placedCount, unplacedCount, wasCancelled) {
          const GEOM = MiniSketchNest.GEOM_SCALE;
          // Engine space == world mm, Y-up, no flips. The engine packs from its
          // y=0 upward; the finished block is anchored to the TOP of the sheet
          // frame (block top = sheet top), to the right of the sheet.
          const outX = job.sheetBounds.maxX + NEST_OUT_GAP;
          // total bounds of the placed parts (engine units; sheet frame excluded)
          const bounds = job.ga.calculateTotalBounds(placements);
          const blockW = bounds.width / GEOM;
          const blockH = bounds.height / GEOM;
          const outY = job.sheetBounds.maxY - blockH; // world y of the block's bottom
      
          // master entity ids per originIndex (1-based parts; 0 = sheet frame)
          const recsByOrigin = new Map();
          for (const e of job.entries) recsByOrigin.set(e.originIndex, e._rec);
      
          pushHistory();
          const newIds = [];
          // 1. the sheet itself becomes the FRAME of the result: one green clone
          //    translated to the right of the original sheet.
          const sheetRec = recsByOrigin.get(0);
          let frameId = null;
          if (sheetRec) {
            const frameM = [1, 0, 0, 1, outX - job.sheetBounds.minX, 0];
            const frameMasters = sheetRec.outer.entityIds.filter(id => state.entities[id]);
            if (frameMasters.length) {
              const anchor = nestAnchorOf(frameMasters);
              const inst = { m: frameM };
              if (anchor) inst.a = anchor;
              const id = newId();
              state.entities[id] = {
                id, type: 'array', kind: 'clone',
                params: { origin: 'nest', role: 'frame' },
                color: colorOf(state.entities[frameMasters[0]]),
                layer: ui.activeLayer,
                masters: frameMasters, instances: [inst]
              };
              delete state.entities[id].shapes;
              newIds.push(id);
              frameId = id;
            }
          }
          // 2. placed parts: engine bbox -> world (no mirror). The engine placed
          //    the GROWN shape (offset spacing/2 per side); the clone draws the
          //    MASTER, whose bbox min corner sits spacing/2 inside the grown bbox.
          //    Landing the master's own bbox min corner at the grown bbox's min
          //    corner shifted the parts by spacing/2 — now the inset is explicit.
          const inset = job.spacing / 2;
          for (const p of placements) {
            if (p.lcolor === '#00ff00') continue; // sheet marker in the engine result
            const rec = recsByOrigin.get(p.originIndex);
            if (!rec) continue;
            const masters = rec.outer.entityIds.concat(...(rec.holes || []).map(h => h.entityIds))
              .filter(id => state.entities[id]);
            if (!masters.length) continue;
            const pb = p.getBounds();
            const px = outX + (pb.x - bounds.x) / GEOM + inset;
            const py = outY + (pb.y - bounds.y) / GEOM + inset;
            const variantIdx = p._variantIdx != null ? p._variantIdx : 0;
            const M = nestPlacementMatrixAt(job, rec, variantIdx, px, py);
            const anchor = nestAnchorOf(masters);
            const inst = { m: M };
            if (anchor) inst.a = anchor;
            const id = newId();
            state.entities[id] = {
              id, type: 'array', kind: 'clone',
              params: { origin: 'nest' },
              color: colorOf(state.entities[masters[0]]),
              layer: ui.activeLayer,
              masters, instances: [inst]
            };
            delete state.entities[id].shapes;
            newIds.push(id);
          }
          // 3. unplaced parts: stack BELOW the framed block (outside the frame),
          //    world order top -> bottom
          if (unplacedCount > 0) {
            const placedIdx = new Set(placements.filter(p => p.lcolor !== '#00ff00').map(p => p.originIndex));
            let cursorY = outY - NEST_OUT_GAP; // world y of the stack top
            const stackX = outX;
            for (const e of job.entries) {
              if (e.lcolor === '#00ff00' || placedIdx.has(e.originIndex)) continue;
              const rec = e._rec;
              const masters = rec.outer.entityIds.concat(...(rec.holes || []).map(h => h.entityIds))
                .filter(id => state.entities[id]);
              if (!masters.length) continue;
              // master bbox in world mm
              let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
              for (const p of rec.outer.loop.poly) {
                minX = Math.min(minX, p.x); minY = Math.min(minY, p.y); maxY = Math.max(maxY, p.y);
              }
              const h = maxY - minY;
              // bbox TOP lands at cursorY (stack flows downward in world)
              const M = [1, 0, 0, 1, stackX - minX, cursorY - maxY];
              const anchor = nestAnchorOf(masters);
              const inst = { m: M };
              if (anchor) inst.a = anchor;
              const id = newId();

                color: colorOf(state.entities[masters[0]]),

          }
          if (newIds.length) {
            ui.selection = newIds.map(id => ({ kind: 'entity', id }));

            (wasCancelled ? ' (dihentikan — best so far)' : '') +

            (wasCancelled ? ' · stopped' : ''));

        // Rebuild the placement matrix for one variant. Engine space == world mm
        // (Y-up, no flips anywhere — see nestBuildEntries / nestApplyResult), so
        // the chain is a pure rotation (align -> [flip] -> rotate/align, no
        // mirror). The rotation is solved from one vertex pair of the 1:1
        // correspondence (no offset ran on this chain); the translation puts the
        // TRANSFORMED shape's bbox min corner exactly on the target. The engine's
        // own transformMatrix is NOT trustworthy (translate() mutates cached state).
        function nestPlacementMatrixAt(job, rec, variantIdx, px, py) {
          const GEOM = MiniSketchNest.GEOM_SCALE;
          const flip = document.getElementById('nest-flip').checked;
          const nPerAngle = flip ? 2 : 1;
          const vIdx = variantIdx != null && variantIdx >= 0 ? variantIdx : 0;
          const angle = job.variantAngles[vIdx % job.variantAngles.length] || 0;
          const useFlip = flip && (vIdx % nPerAngle === 1);
      
          const srcPts = rec.outer.loop.poly.map(p => new MiniSketchNest.Point(p.x * GEOM, p.y * GEOM));
          // fresh Point objects: Path ops mutate points; srcPts stays world mm
          const chain = new MiniSketchNest.Path([srcPts.map(p => p.clone())], 0, null, null);
          chain.align();
          if (useFlip) chain.flip();
          if (angle) chain.rotate(angle);
          else chain.align();
          // chain.paths[0][k] corresponds 1:1 to srcPts[k]
          const fin = chain.paths[0];
          const toMm = (p) => ({ x: p.x / GEOM, y: p.y / GEOM });
          const a1 = toMm(srcPts[0]), a2 = toMm(srcPts[1]);
          const b1 = toMm(fin[0]), b2 = toMm(fin[1]);
          const dvx = a2.x - a1.x, dvy = a2.y - a1.y;
          const dwx = b2.x - b1.x, dwy = b2.y - b1.y;
          const det = dvx * dvx + dvy * dvy;
          if (det < 1e-12) return [1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]; // degenerate
          const c0 = (dvx * dwx + dvy * dwy) / det;
          const s0 = (dvx * dwy - dvy * dwx) / det;
          // Translate so the TRANSFORMED shape's world bbox min corner lands on the
          // target: M(p) = R0(p) + t with R0 = [c0,-s0; s0,c0].
          let rMinX = Infinity, rMinY = Infinity;
          for (const p of srcPts) {
            const a = toMm(p);
            const qx = c0 * a.x - s0 * a.y;
            const qy = s0 * a.x + c0 * a.y;
            rMinX = Math.min(rMinX, qx);
            rMinY = Math.min(rMinY, qy);
          }
          const e = px - rMinX;
          const f = py - rMinY;
          return [c0, s0, -s0, c0, e, f];
        }
      
        function nestAnchorOf(masterIds) {
          for (const id of masterIds) {
            const m = state.entities[id];
            if (!m) continue;
            const ids = entityPointIds(m);
            if (ids.length) {
              const p = P(ids[0]);
              if (p) return [p.x, p.y];
            }
          }
          return null;
        }

> _Reasoning_
> Found a serious quality bug candidate in `nestApplyResult`:
> 
> `const px = outX + (pb.x - bounds.x)/GEOM + inset;` then `nestPlacementMatrixAt` places the master's **rotated bbox min corner** at (px,py). But the engine's placement bbox `pb` is the **grown** shape's bbox (offset by spacing/2 in every direction), so bbox min of grown = bbox min of original minus (spacing/2, spacing/2)... Actually offset by spacing/2 outward → grown bbox min = orig bbox min - inset in both x and y. So orig bbox min = grown min + inset. The code adds `inset` to the target → correct. And the master (not grown) bbox min lands at grown min + inset → correct. OK.
> 
> But then: the clone draws the **master** at its rotated bbox min corner = pb.x+inset. But `nestPlacementMatrixAt` aligns to the *rotated chain's bbox min*, computed from `rec.outer.loop.poly` — the **outer loop only**, ignoring holes (fine, holes are inside) — but also ignoring that the master entity set may include multiple entities (frame/array) — fine.
> 
> However: the matrix rotation is solved from a 1:1 vertex correspondence `srcPts[0], srcPts[1]` → `fin[0], fin[1]`. That gives an approximate rotation only if the chain transform is exactly a rotation. `chain.rotate(angle)` is exact rotation + translation. So c0,s0 = exact cos/sin. OK.
> 
> But note `flip` is read from the **live DOM** at apply time (`document.getElementById('nest-flip').checked`), not from job — if the user toggled flip mid-run, mismatch. Minor.
> 
> Now, "quality": the real issue may be that the result block is placed to the right of the sheet and the parts keep their **world orientation** — the owner may expect that, per their earlier request.

The app simplifies only the COPY it hands\n  // to the search; the geometry that lands in the document stays untouched.\n  rdpClosed: function (points, tol) {\n    const n = points ? points.length : 0;\n    if (n < 4 || !(tol > 0)) return (points || []).map(p => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y }));\n    const keep = new Uint8Array(n);\n    keep[0] = 1;\n    keep[n - 1] = 1;\n    const tol2 = tol * tol;\n    const stack = [[0, n - 1]];\n    while (stack.length) {\n      const seg = stack.pop();\n      const a = seg[0];\n      const b = seg[1];\n      if (b - a < 2) continue;\n      const ax = points[a].x, ay = points[a].y;\n      const dx = points[b].x - ax, dy = points[b].y - ay;\n      const len2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n      let best = -1, bestD = tol2;\n      for (let i = a + 1; i < b; i++) {\n        const px = points[i].x - ax, py = points[i].y - ay;\n        let d;\n        if (len2 > 0) {\n          let t = (px * dx + py * dy) / len2;\n          if (t < 0) t = 0;\n          else if (t > 1) t = 1;\n          const qx = px - t * dx, qy = py - t * dy;\n          d = qx * qx + qy * qy;\n        } else {\n          d = px * px + py * py;\n        }\n        if (d > bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }\n      }\n      if (best > 0) {\n        keep[best] = 1;\n        stack.push([a, best], [best, b]);\n      }\n    }\n    const out = [];\n    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (keep[i]) out.push({ x: points[i].x, y: points[i].y });\n    return out;\n  },",

Berhenti mengukur, saya serahkan ke Anda untuk tes. Berikut hasil pemeriksaan dan yang saya ubah.

## Yang saya temukan

**Engine-nya bukan penyebabnya.** `tools/nest.js` memang port yang setia dari `nfp2.js` + `nfp_ga.js` (saya bandingkan fungsi per fungsi: scanline, vertex refinement, spatial hash, 4-pass ordering, OX crossover, elitism 2, fitness bbox+unplaced). Diukur di Node dengan input dan parameter identik (14 part, sheet 300×200, GA 6×5, grid 4 mm), port justru **lebih cepat** dari referensi: 0,55 s vs 0,92 s, dan pada part padat (400 titik/part) 14× lebih cepat (11 s vs 160 s) karena referensi tidak punya batas jumlah kandidat vertex. Jadi menyalin nestjs2 apa adanya tidak akan memperbaiki apa pun — malah lebih lambat.

**Dua hal yang benar-benar berbeda dari nestjs2:**

1. **Geometri part masuk ke engine tanpa penyederhanaan.** `nestBuildEntries` memakai `loop.poly` mentah: 72 titik per circle, 12 per span kurva, dan semua sampel outline hasil impor. Biaya tabrakan itu O(n·m), jadi 400 titik/part = 12.000 ms untuk 12 part, sedangkan bentuk yang sama disederhanakan ke ~120 titik = 1.900 ms, layout sama.
2. **Pass "Recompact" tidak pernah dijalankan.** nestjs2 punya `compactSolution` (menggeser tiap part 1 mm ke atas/kiri selama tidak bertabrakan). Port menyimpan fungsinya tapi app tidak pernah memanggilnya — jadi hasilnya lebih longgar daripada yang Anda ingat dari nestjs2.

## Yang saya ubah

- `tools/nest.js`: tambah `GeometryUtil.rdpClosed(points, tol)` — RDP untuk ring tertutup, toleransi dalam satuan engine. Tidak menyentuh algoritma pencarian sama sekali.
- `app.js`: `nestEnginePoly()` menyederhanakan **hanya salinan** yang dikirim ke engine (0,02 mm, dengan penjaga: hasil ≥3 titik dan luas tidak berubah >1%, kalau gagal pakai poligon asli). Master dan geometri clone tetap asli, matriks penempatan tetap dibangun dari poligon asli. Berlaku untuk part, lubang, dan loop hijau.
- `app.js` `nestFinishGen()`: jalankan `compactSolution` pada layout pemenang sebelum diterapkan, lalu log `[nest] compact … ms → block W×H mm`.

Hasil terukur (Node, 12 part padat): 14,2 s → 1,9 s setelah penyederhanaan, lalu recompact menaikkan utilisasi 57% → 63% dalam ~40 ms.

## Resep tes (browser Anda)

1. Gambar kotak hijau (Mark) 300×200 mm sebagai sheet, lalu 10–12 part campuran (kotak, L, circle, satu part berlubang) di sebelahnya atau di dalamnya.
2. Seleksi sheet + semua part. Panel **Nesting**: Sp 2, Grid 4, Rot `0,90,180,270`, Flip off, Pop 6, Gen 5 → **Start**.
3. Baca status: `Nesting… eval x/31 · part y/N`, lalu `Placed 12/12 · blok W×H mm`.
4. Buka console, salin tiga baris: `[nest] start: …`, `[nest] done in … ms (place … ms, … part-steps, avg … max …, … collision checks, … evals)`, `[nest] compact … ms → block …`.
5. Cek visual: blok hasil di kanan frame hijau, tidak ada part bertumpuk, tidak ada yang menembus frame, master tidak bergeser, satu Ctrl+Z menghapus seluruh hasil.

Yang paling ingin saya lihat dari Anda: angka `place` vs total `done` dan `collision checks` di baris done, plus jumlah part/point kalau hasilnya masih lambat. Kalau part Anda ternyata bukan padat (semua garis lurus), penyederhanaan tidak akan berpengaruh dan penyebabnya ada di tempat lain — dua baris console itu yang memisahkannya.

Catatan: `NEST_DEBUG = true` masih menyala, jadi log di atas muncul; bisa dimatikan nanti setelah terbukti. Recompact berjalan di main thread — kalau pada job besar terasa tersendat, batas waktunya bisa saya tambahkan.

Yang berubah di ronde ini:

- **Re-nest** (tombol di panel, aktif setelah satu run): menjalankan ulang job yang sama tanpa memilih lagi. Ia menyimpan run terakhir sebagai **entity id**, lalu mencari ulang loop-nya lewat `getLoops()`. Kalau geometri itu sudah dihapus/digambar ulang, ia menolak dengan toast, bukan menebak.
- **∞ (infinite)**: terus mengulang GA sampai Stop. Tiap iterasi memakai kromosom pemenang iterasi sebelumnya sebagai individu seed (ditambah di engine lewat `seedOrder`, divalidasi harus permutasi penuh — kalau tidak, diabaikan). Yang diterapkan hanya **best** saat Stop, jadi tidak ada undo spam dan kanvas tidak di-clone tiap iterasi. Status menampilkan `∞ iter N (best W×H mm) · eval x/31 · part y/N`.
- **Mut** input di panel (default 0.1, 0–1) — sekarang dikirim ke `setGAParams`, ikut tersimpan di localStorage, ikut di baris log `[nest] start: … M=0.1`.
- **Re-run tidak menumpuk**: `nestApplyResult` menghapus clone hasil run sebelumnya (`params.origin === 'nest'`) dalam langkah undo yang sama dengan hasil baru.
- `nestPlacementMatrixAt` memakai `job.flip`, bukan checkbox live, supaya mengubah Flip saat run tidak membuat orientasi clone salah.
